Crie `src/digitalizadora/domain/document_draft.py`:

```python
import re
import secrets
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path

from digitalizadora.domain.color_mode import ColorMode
from digitalizadora.domain.errors import EmptyDocumentError, InvalidPageOrderError, PageNotFoundError
from digitalizadora.domain.scan_result import ScanResult

PAGE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{16}")
PAGE_IDENTIFIER_SIZE_IN_BYTES = 8
DRAFT_SESSION_SIZE_IN_BYTES = 8
FIRST_PAGE_POSITION = 1


def generate_page_identifier() -> str:
    return secrets.token_hex(PAGE_IDENTIFIER_SIZE_IN_BYTES)


def generate_draft_session() -> str:
    return secrets.token_hex(DRAFT_SESSION_SIZE_IN_BYTES)


def is_page_identifier(text: str) -> bool:
    return isinstance(text, str) and PAGE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.fullmatch(text) is not None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DocumentPage:
    page_identifier: str
    scanned_at: datetime
    dots_per_inch: int
    color_mode: ColorMode
    size_in_bytes: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DocumentPageFiles:
    page_identifier: str
    jpeg_content: bytes
    thumbnail_jpeg: bytes


def _is_exact_permutation(requested_order: tuple[object, ...], current_order: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    if not all(isinstance(page_identifier, str) for page_identifier in requested_order):
        return False
    return len(requested_order) == len(current_order) and set(requested_order) == set(current_order)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DocumentDraft:
    """The draft in progress; the order of pages is the order of the final PDF.

    Every content change returns a new draft without both finalization markers, because a PDF
    written before the change no longer matches the draft.
    """

    name: str
    created_at: datetime
    pages: tuple[DocumentPage, ...]
    finalization_started_at: datetime | None = None
    finished_document: ScanResult | None = None

    @classmethod
    def start(cls, first_page: DocumentPage) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return cls(name="", created_at=first_page.scanned_at, pages=(first_page,))

    @property
    def page_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.pages)

    @property
    def page_identifiers(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(page.page_identifier for page in self.pages)

    @property
    def estimated_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
        return sum(page.size_in_bytes for page in self.pages)

    def position_of(self, page_identifier: str) -> int:
        if page_identifier not in self.page_identifiers:
            raise PageNotFoundError(f"Page {page_identifier!r} is not in the draft")
        return self.page_identifiers.index(page_identifier) + FIRST_PAGE_POSITION

    def with_page_appended(self, page: DocumentPage) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return self._with_content(self.name, (*self.pages, page))

    def without_page(self, page_identifier: str) -> "DocumentDraft":
        removed_position = self.position_of(page_identifier)
        remaining_pages = tuple(
            page for position, page in enumerate(self.pages, FIRST_PAGE_POSITION) if position != removed_position
        )
        return self._with_content(self.name, remaining_pages)

    def without_last_page(self) -> "DocumentDraft":
        if not self.pages:
            raise EmptyDocumentError("The draft has no page to discard")
        return self._with_content(self.name, self.pages[:-1])

    def reordered(self, page_identifiers: Sequence[str]) -> "DocumentDraft":
        requested_order = tuple(page_identifiers)
        if not _is_exact_permutation(requested_order, self.page_identifiers):
            raise InvalidPageOrderError(f"{list(requested_order)!r} is not a permutation of the draft pages")
        pages_by_identifier = {page.page_identifier: page for page in self.pages}
        return self._with_content(self.name, tuple(pages_by_identifier[identifier] for identifier in requested_order))

    def renamed(self, document_name: str) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return self._with_content(document_name, self.pages)

    def with_finalization_started(self, started_at: datetime) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return replace(self, finalization_started_at=started_at)

    def without_finalization_marker(self) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return replace(self, finalization_started_at=None)

    def marked_finished(self, finished_document: ScanResult) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return replace(self, finished_document=finished_document)

    def _with_content(self, name: str, pages: tuple[DocumentPage, ...]) -> "DocumentDraft":
        return DocumentDraft(name=name, created_at=self.created_at, pages=pages)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DocumentFinalizationResult:
    result: ScanResult
    page_count: int


class RecoveryOutcome(str, Enum):
    RESUMED = "resumed"
    PAGES_LOST = "pages_lost"
    SET_ASIDE = "set_aside"
    FAILED = "failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DraftRecoveryReport:
    outcome: RecoveryOutcome
    kept_page_count: int
    dropped_page_positions: tuple[int, ...]
    set_aside_folder: Path | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DraftSnapshot:
    """Replaced as a whole in a single assignment, so a reader on another thread sees a coherent state."""

    draft_session: str
    revision: int
    draft: DocumentDraft | None
    recovery_report: DraftRecoveryReport | None = None
    last_finished_document: DocumentFinalizationResult | None = None
```

- [ ] **Passo 15: Implementar o mínimo**

Crie `src/digitalizadora/domain/document_draft_reconciliation.py`:

```python
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace

from digitalizadora.domain.document_draft import FIRST_PAGE_POSITION, DocumentDraft

MANIFEST_FILE_NAME = "manifest.json"
PAGE_FILE_PREFIX = "page-"
THUMBNAIL_FILE_PREFIX = "thumbnail-"
JPEG_FILE_SUFFIX = ".jpg"


def page_file_name(page_identifier: str) -> str:
    return f"{PAGE_FILE_PREFIX}{page_identifier}{JPEG_FILE_SUFFIX}"


def thumbnail_file_name(page_identifier: str) -> str:
    return f"{THUMBNAIL_FILE_PREFIX}{page_identifier}{JPEG_FILE_SUFFIX}"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DraftFileInventory:
    """What the draft folder holds, already classified by file name (manifest.json excluded)."""

    page_file_sizes: Mapping[str, int]
    thumbnail_identifiers: frozenset[str]
    temporary_file_names: frozenset[str]
    unknown_file_names: frozenset[str]

    @property
    def known_file_names(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        page_file_names = [page_file_name(page_identifier) for page_identifier in self.page_file_sizes]
        thumbnail_file_names = [thumbnail_file_name(page_identifier) for page_identifier in self.thumbnail_identifiers]
        return tuple(sorted([*page_file_names, *thumbnail_file_names, *self.temporary_file_names]))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DraftReconciliation:
    draft: DocumentDraft
    dropped_page_positions: tuple[int, ...]
    files_to_set_aside: tuple[str, ...]
    files_to_delete: tuple[str, ...]


def reconcile_draft(draft: DocumentDraft, inventory: DraftFileInventory) -> DraftReconciliation:
    """Keeps only the pages whose file has the size the manifest recorded.

    A confirmed page with another size is set aside, never deleted; files that were never confirmed are
    deleted; unknown names are left alone.
    """
    kept_pages = []
    dropped_page_positions = []
    files_to_set_aside = []
    dropped_identifiers = set()
    for position, page in enumerate(draft.pages, FIRST_PAGE_POSITION):
        file_size = inventory.page_file_sizes.get(page.page_identifier)
        if file_size == page.size_in_bytes:
            kept_pages.append(page)
            continue
        dropped_page_positions.append(position)
        dropped_identifiers.add(page.page_identifier)
        if file_size is not None:
            files_to_set_aside.append(page_file_name(page.page_identifier))
    listed_identifiers = set(draft.page_identifiers)
    unlisted_page_files = [
        page_file_name(page_identifier)
        for page_identifier in inventory.page_file_sizes
        if page_identifier not in listed_identifiers
    ]
    discarded_thumbnails = [
        thumbnail_file_name(page_identifier)
        for page_identifier in inventory.thumbnail_identifiers
        if page_identifier not in listed_identifiers or page_identifier in dropped_identifiers
    ]
    return DraftReconciliation(
        draft=replace(draft, pages=tuple(kept_pages)),
        dropped_page_positions=tuple(dropped_page_positions),
        files_to_set_aside=tuple(sorted(files_to_set_aside)),
        files_to_delete=tuple(sorted([*inventory.temporary_file_names, *unlisted_page_files, *discarded_thumbnails])),
    )
```

- [ ] **Passo 19: Implementar o mínimo**

Crie `src/digitalizadora/domain/document_name_policy.py`:

```python
import re
import unicodedata

from digitalizadora.domain.errors import InvalidDocumentNameError

MAXIMUM_DOCUMENT_NAME_CHARACTERS = 120
MAXIMUM_DOCUMENT_NAME_BYTES = 200
FORBIDDEN_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS = frozenset('/\\:*?"<>|')
FORBIDDEN_CHARACTER_REPLACEMENT = "-"
REMOVED_UNICODE_CATEGORIES = frozenset({"Cc", "Cf", "Cs"})
PDF_FILE_SUFFIX = ".pdf"
UNICODE_NORMAL_FORM = "NFC"
NAME_ENCODING = "utf-8"
SPACE = " "
REPEATED_SPACES_PATTERN = re.compile(" {2,}")
EDGE_CHARACTERS_TO_STRIP = ". "
FIRST_ATTEMPT_NUMBER = 1


def _clean_character(character: str) -> str:
    if character.isspace():
        return SPACE
    if character in FORBIDDEN_FILE_NAME_CHARACTERS:
        return FORBIDDEN_CHARACTER_REPLACEMENT
    if unicodedata.category(character) in REMOVED_UNICODE_CATEGORIES:
        return ""
    return character


def _without_pdf_suffix(name: str) -> str:
    if name.lower().endswith(PDF_FILE_SUFFIX):
        return name[: -len(PDF_FILE_SUFFIX)]
    return name


def clean_document_name(raw_name: str) -> str:
    """Turns what the user typed into a file name that APFS and exFAT accept; "" means the automatic name.

    A name that is too long is refused, never cut short silently.
    """
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize(UNICODE_NORMAL_FORM, raw_name)
    replaced = "".join(_clean_character(character) for character in normalized)
    collapsed = REPEATED_SPACES_PATTERN.sub(SPACE, replaced).strip(SPACE)
    cleaned = _without_pdf_suffix(collapsed).lstrip(EDGE_CHARACTERS_TO_STRIP).rstrip(EDGE_CHARACTERS_TO_STRIP)
    if not cleaned:
        if not raw_name.strip():
            return ""
        raise InvalidDocumentNameError(f"{raw_name!r} has no visible character left after cleaning")
    too_many_characters = len(cleaned) > MAXIMUM_DOCUMENT_NAME_CHARACTERS
    too_many_bytes = len(cleaned.encode(NAME_ENCODING)) > MAXIMUM_DOCUMENT_NAME_BYTES
    if too_many_characters or too_many_bytes:
        raise InvalidDocumentNameError(f"{cleaned!r} is longer than a document name may be")
    return cleaned


def build_document_file_name(document_name: str, attempt_number: int) -> str:
    """The first attempt is "<name>.pdf"; attempt n is "<name> (n).pdf". Receives an already clean name."""
    if attempt_number == FIRST_ATTEMPT_NUMBER:
        return f"{document_name}{PDF_FILE_SUFFIX}"
    return f"{document_name} ({attempt_number}){PDF_FILE_SUFFIX}"
```

- Produces (contrato 6.3): `settings.json` com a quarta chave `"capture_mode"`; na leitura, a chave é lida sozinha (`parse_capture_mode(document)`, função pública nova do módulo, ao lado de `parse_application_settings`).
- Produces (contrato 6.5): `SettingsUpdate.capture_mode: str | None = None` e `SettingsRequestBody.capture_mode: str | None = None` (ausente ou `null` mantém o modo salvo); `build_settings_body` com a quarta chave `"capture_mode"`, o que leva a chave a `GET /api/settings`, `PUT /api/settings` e `settings` de `GET /api/state`.

**Notas da tarefa**
- Compatibilidade nos dois sentidos: um `settings.json` antigo, sem a chave, vale `"single"`; um valor que esta versão não conhece (de uma versão mais nova, ou escrito à mão) também vale `"single"`, **sem** devolver os outros ajustes ao padrão, porque perder a pasta de saída mandaria os scans de volta ao disco interno. As três chaves de hoje continuam com a regra de hoje: qualquer uma inválida devolve os ajustes padrão inteiros.
- Aviso no log: só o valor desconhecido gera um `WARNING`. O arquivo sem a chave **não** gera aviso, porque é o caso normal de quem atualiza o app e porque o `ApplicationStateService` lê os ajustes a cada `GET /api/state` (a página consulta a cada 2 s parada e a cada 0,5 s durante uma digitalização): um aviso por leitura encheria o registro em `~/Library/Logs/Digitalizadora` até o primeiro `PUT`. Pela mesma razão o valor desconhecido gera o `WARNING` só na primeira leitura de cada valor, por instância do repositório (`_reported_capture_mode_text`): `parse_capture_mode` é pura e o repositório decide quando avisar.
- `PUT /api/settings` com o corpo antigo, de três chaves (a página da Tarefa 12 ainda manda assim), mantém o modo salvo: o serviço lê `current().capture_mode` só quando `capture_mode` é `None`. O modo é conferido antes de preparar a pasta de saída, então um modo desconhecido responde `422 invalid_settings` sem criar pasta e sem gravar nada. Um modo que não é texto (por exemplo `1`) nem chega ao serviço: o `pydantic` recusa o corpo e o tratador da fábrica responde o mesmo `422 invalid_settings`.
- Testes que mudam porque conferem o formato exato dos ajustes (lista da seção 6.9 do design): `test_save_writes_the_documented_json_shape`, `test_get_settings_returns_the_saved_settings`, `test_put_settings_returns_the_new_settings`, `test_state_contains_the_settings`, `SETTINGS_BODY` de `test_application_factory.py` e `test_state_endpoint_reports_default_settings`. Nos testes de controller, os ajustes iniciais passam a estar no modo Documento, para que a chave mostrada prove que o modo salvo chega à resposta (e não só o padrão). `tests/integration/test_scan_flow.py` e `tests/web/` não mudam: a página ainda manda o corpo de três chaves e ignora a chave nova.

Cobertura do Review Focus: modo (2) do design (abertura depois de uma atualização ou de uma volta de versão): arquivo sem a chave e arquivo com modo desconhecido mantendo a pasta de saída, sem cair no disco interno; modo (3) (pedidos concorrentes de clientes de versões diferentes): `PUT` de três chaves mantém o modo, `null` mantém o modo, modo desconhecido ou que não é texto responde `422 invalid_settings` sem gravar e sem preparar a pasta.

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, logo depois de `LOGGER`, acrescente:

```python
CAPTURE_MODE_KEY = "capture_mode"
KNOWN_CAPTURE_MODE_VALUES = frozenset(capture_mode.value for capture_mode in CaptureMode)


def parse_capture_mode(document: dict[str, object]) -> CaptureMode:
    """Reads the capture mode on its own, so an unknown value never discards the output folder.

    A missing key is a file written before the mode existed and means the quick mode;
    any other value this version does not know also means the quick mode (the repository reports it).
    """
    raw_capture_mode = document.get(CAPTURE_MODE_KEY, CaptureMode.SINGLE.value)
    if isinstance(raw_capture_mode, str) and raw_capture_mode in KNOWN_CAPTURE_MODE_VALUES:
        return CaptureMode(raw_capture_mode)
    return CaptureMode.SINGLE


def find_unknown_capture_mode_text(document: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
    """The text of a capture mode this version does not know, or None when the key is missing or known."""
    if CAPTURE_MODE_KEY not in document:
        return None
    raw_capture_mode = document[CAPTURE_MODE_KEY]
    if isinstance(raw_capture_mode, str) and raw_capture_mode in KNOWN_CAPTURE_MODE_VALUES:
        return None
    return repr(raw_capture_mode)
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, substitua por inteiro `parse_application_settings` por:

```python
def parse_application_settings(document: object) -> ApplicationSettings:
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise ValueError("The settings document must be a JSON object")
    output_folder_text = document["output_folder"]
    if not isinstance(output_folder_text, str):
        raise ValueError("The output folder must be text")
    output_folder = Path(output_folder_text)
    if not output_folder.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("The output folder must be an absolute path")
    return ApplicationSettings(
        output_folder=output_folder,
        output_format=OutputFormat(document["output_format"]),
        scan_preset=ScanPreset(document["scan_preset"]),
        capture_mode=parse_capture_mode(document),
    )
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, substitua por inteiro o método `__init__` da classe `JsonApplicationSettingsRepository` por (as reticências `...` representam o resto da classe, que não muda):

```python
class JsonApplicationSettingsRepository:
    ...
    def __init__(
        self,
        storage_file: Path,
        default_settings: ApplicationSettings,
        file_writer: AtomicFileWriter,
    ) -> None:
        self._storage_file = storage_file
        self._default_settings = default_settings
        self._file_writer = file_writer
        # The state endpoint reads the settings on every poll: each unknown mode is reported once, not once per read.
        self._reported_capture_mode_text: str | None = None
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, substitua por inteiro o método `load` da classe `JsonApplicationSettingsRepository` por (as reticências `...` representam o resto da classe, que não muda):

```python
class JsonApplicationSettingsRepository:
    ...
    def load(self) -> ApplicationSettings:
        try:
            document = json.loads(self._storage_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            settings = parse_application_settings(document)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return self._default_settings
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
            LOGGER.warning("Using the default settings because %s is unusable: %r", self._storage_file, error)
            return self._default_settings
        self._report_unknown_capture_mode(document)
        return settings
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, acrescente ao final da classe `JsonApplicationSettingsRepository` (depois do último método; as reticências `...` representam o resto da classe):

```python
class JsonApplicationSettingsRepository:
    ...
    def _report_unknown_capture_mode(self, document: dict[str, object]) -> None:
        unknown_capture_mode_text = find_unknown_capture_mode_text(document)
        if unknown_capture_mode_text is None or unknown_capture_mode_text == self._reported_capture_mode_text:
            return
        self._reported_capture_mode_text = unknown_capture_mode_text
        LOGGER.warning(
            "Using the single capture mode because %s is not a known capture mode", unknown_capture_mode_text
        )
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/json_application_settings_repository.py`, substitua por inteiro o método `save` da classe `JsonApplicationSettingsRepository` por (as reticências `...` representam o resto da classe, que não muda):

```python
class JsonApplicationSettingsRepository:
    ...
    def save(self, settings: ApplicationSettings) -> None:
        document = {
            "output_folder": str(settings.output_folder),
            "output_format": settings.output_format.value,
            "scan_preset": settings.scan_preset.value,
            CAPTURE_MODE_KEY: settings.capture_mode.value,
        }
        self._storage_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        encoded_document = json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
        self._file_writer.replace_file(self._storage_file, encoded_document)
```

```python
        scan_preset = parse_enum_member(ScanPreset, update.scan_preset, "scan preset")
```

### Task 17: Persistência do rascunho, gravação em fluxo e PDF com resoluções misturadas

**Objetivo:** Implementar a parte de disco do modo Documento: a gravação em fluxo sem sobrescrever (`AtomicFileWriter.write_new_file_from`), o manifesto versionado do rascunho com leitura estrita (`encode_manifest`/`decode_manifest`), o repositório do rascunho com o lock de processo único, as gravações atômicas de página e miniatura, o inventário, o pôr de lado e o apagar com o manifesto primeiro (`FileSystemDocumentDraftRepository`), o PDF com nome escolhido na pasta de saída (`FileSystemScanOutputRepository.save_document`), a conferência de espaço para um arquivo de tamanho conhecido e a montagem do PDF que respeita a densidade de cada página sem juntar as páginas na memória. Nenhuma regra de negócio além da tradução de erros: decidir o que fazer com uma sobra, quando gravar e quando apagar é das Tarefas 18b, 18c e 19.

As Tarefas 18b, 18c, 19 e 20 importam daqui.

**Notas da tarefa**
- Gravação em fluxo (R18): `write_new_file` passa a delegar para `write_new_file_from` com um `functools.partial(write_bytes, content)`, então os dois seguem a mesma sequência (temporário exclusivo, `F_FULLFSYNC`, `os.link` sem sobrescrever ou `rename` no exFAT, `fsync` da pasta). O destino que já existe é recusado **antes** de chamar o callback; por isso o `save_document` pula um nome ocupado sem montar o PDF, e só uma corrida real (outro processo criou o nome durante a montagem) monta de novo no nome seguinte. Uma exceção do callback remove o temporário e sobe sem tradução; no `save_document`, um `OSError` vindo do fluxo (disco de saída cheio no meio da escrita) passa pela mesma `translate_storage_error` do `save`, e `ScanFailedError` e `MemoryError` sobem iguais, para a Tarefa 19 os traduzir em `document_assembly_failed` e `document_too_large`.
- `ScriptedFileWriter`: só sobrescreve `write_new_file_from` e `replace_file`; o `write_new_file` herdado delega para `write_new_file_from`, então cada gravação aparece uma única vez em `written_file_names`. A falha configurada acontece uma vez por nome, não grava nada e não entra na lista (a lista é das gravações que deram certo; "manifesto não regravado" na Tarefa 18c é `written_file_names == []`).
- Montagem do PDF (R2, R18): `write_pdf_at_embedded_resolutions` usa `img2pdf.default_layout_fun`, então cada página sai com o tamanho físico da própria densidade JFIF (que o `ScanEncoder` já normalizou para o `dots_per_inch` da página): 300 × 150 px a 300 dpi e 600 × 300 px a 600 dpi dão a mesma página de 72 × 36 pt. As páginas são lidas pelo caminho e o PDF vai direto para o fluxo recebido. Os caminhos vão como `bytes` (`os.fsencode`), não como `str`: o `img2pdf` trata um caminho que não consegue abrir como se fosse o conteúdo da imagem, e com `str` isso vira `TypeError` (`a bytes-like object is required, not 'str'`); com `bytes` vira `ImageOpenError` e, daqui, `ScanFailedError`, então uma página que sumiu entre a conferência e a montagem chega à Tarefa 19 como `document_assembly_failed`, não como `unexpected_error`. `build_pdf` continua com o dpi fixo; os dois métodos passam pelo mesmo `_conversion_options(metadata, layout_function)`, com a função de layout sempre informada.
- Manifesto (6.3): `encode_manifest` grava UTF-8 com `ensure_ascii=False`, `indent=2` e as chaves na ordem documentada; `decode_manifest(encode_manifest(draft)) == draft` para qualquer rascunho, inclusive com `pages: []`. Qualquer violação das regras de leitura vira `UnreadableDraftError` com o motivo em inglês; `format_version` tem de ser o inteiro `1` (nem `true`, nem `1.0`, nem `"1"`, nem `2`); chaves desconhecidas são ignoradas e as duas chaves de marca ausentes valem `null`. `finished_document` vira `ScanResult(caminho, OutputFormat.PDF, finalized_at, size_in_bytes)`.
- Repositório do rascunho: `claim_exclusive_access` guarda o arquivo de `.owner-lock` aberto num atributo; o lock dura enquanto o objeto existir (no app, até o processo terminar). Por isso o teste de segunda instância guarda a primeira numa variável: um repositório temporário seria coletado na hora e soltaria o lock. `load_manifest` separa o manifesto ilegível (`UnreadableDraftError`, que a retomada põe de lado) de um erro de disco ao ler (`DraftStorageUnavailableError`, que a retomada trata como falha passageira, R13). `take_inventory` trata como pasta ausente (inventário vazio) só a falha ao abrir `current/`; um arquivo de página que some entre a listagem e o `stat` é ignorado (fica ausente do inventário, e a retomada o conta como página faltando) em vez de esvaziar o inventário inteiro e levar a retomada a apagar o rascunho. Classifica só arquivos comuns: `page-<identificador>.jpg` e `thumbnail-<identificador>.jpg` com identificador válido, os temporários `.<nome>.<pid>-<token de 8 hexadecimais>.part` do `AtomicFileWriter` e `.digitalizadora-write-probe-*`; uma pasta, um `.part` sem pid e token, `page-LAST.jpg` ou `.DS_Store` são desconhecidos e nunca são apagados nem movidos (R14). `delete_draft` apaga `manifest.json` e faz o `F_FULLFSYNC` de `current/` antes de qualquer outro arquivo (falha ao apagar o manifesto → `DraftStorageUnavailableError` com tudo no lugar; falha no `F_FULLFSYNC` depois de apagar → só aviso no log, e a exclusão continua); depois apaga só os nomes conhecidos, em ordem alfabética, e remove `current/` se ficou vazia. `delete_files` e `set_aside_files` recusam, com aviso no log, um nome com separador, `.` ou `..`.
- Espaço (6.4): `ensure_space_for_file` exige `MINIMUM_FREE_SPACE_BYTES + file_size_in_bytes`; o `.part` e o nome final são o mesmo arquivo (hard link), então o tamanho não conta em dobro. As duas conferências do guarda passam pelo mesmo `_ensure_free_space`.
- `save_document` no APFS: o volume padrão do macOS não diferencia maiúsculas, então `contrato do apartamento` colide com `Contrato do apartamento.pdf` e vira `contrato do apartamento (2).pdf`. O teste dessa colisão se pula sozinho num volume que diferencia maiúsculas (onde os dois nomes não colidem).

Cobertura do Review Focus do modo Documento: modo (1) página antes da miniatura, miniatura que falha leva a página junto, manifesto trocado só por `replace_file`, apagar o rascunho com o manifesto primeiro e durável, desconhecido sobrevive, `.part` reconhecido; modo (2) `finished_document_exists` só confirma um arquivo de verdade (ausente, pasta no lugar ou pasta fechada → `False`); modo (3) segunda instância na mesma pasta de rascunhos → `DraftFolderInUseError`; modo (4) `save_document` com `(2)`, `(3)`, colisão só de maiúsculas, nome vazio na sequência do dia e o limite de 1000 tentativas; modo (5) ENOSPC e EDQUOT viram `InsufficientDraftStorageError` no rascunho e `InsufficientStorageError` na pasta de saída, e `ensure_space_for_file` no limite exato e 1 byte abaixo; modo (6) páginas de 300 e 600 dpi com o mesmo tamanho físico, em fluxo e na ordem dada.

- [ ] **Passo 3: Implementar o mínimo**

Substitua o conteúdo inteiro de `src/digitalizadora/repositories/atomic_file_writer.py` por (o `write_new_file` passa a delegar para o `write_new_file_from`, e o `replace_file` usa o mesmo `_write_temporary_file`; a sequência de cada um não muda):

```python
import fcntl
import functools
import logging
import os
import secrets
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import BinaryIO

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TEMPORARY_FILE_PREFIX = "."
TEMPORARY_FILE_SUFFIX = ".part"
TEMPORARY_FILE_PERMISSIONS = 0o644
TEMPORARY_TOKEN_SIZE_IN_BYTES = 4


def temporary_path_for(destination: Path) -> Path:
    """Unique per write, so two writers racing for one name never share or delete each other's file."""
    unique_part = f"{os.getpid()}-{secrets.token_hex(TEMPORARY_TOKEN_SIZE_IN_BYTES)}"
    return destination.with_name(f"{TEMPORARY_FILE_PREFIX}{destination.name}.{unique_part}{TEMPORARY_FILE_SUFFIX}")


def remove_temporary_file(temporary: Path) -> None:
    try:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except OSError:
        LOGGER.warning("Could not remove the temporary file %s", temporary)


def flush_to_disk(descriptor: int) -> None:
    """Ask the drive to empty its own cache; plain fsync on macOS only reaches the drive's buffer."""
    try:
        fcntl.fcntl(descriptor, fcntl.F_FULLFSYNC)
    except OSError:
        os.fsync(descriptor)


def write_bytes(content: bytes, stream: BinaryIO) -> None:
    stream.write(content)


class AtomicFileWriter:
    def write_new_file(self, destination: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
        self.write_new_file_from(destination, functools.partial(write_bytes, content))

    def write_new_file_from(self, destination: Path, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None]) -> int:
        """Streams the content into a hidden temporary file and publishes it without overwriting.

        Returns the written size. An exception of the callback removes the temporary file and reaches
        the caller unchanged.
        """
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite {destination}")
        temporary = temporary_path_for(destination)
        try:
            written_size = self._write_temporary_file(temporary, write_content)
            self._publish_without_overwriting(temporary, destination)
        finally:
            remove_temporary_file(temporary)
        self._synchronise_directory(destination.parent)
        return written_size

    def replace_file(self, destination: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
        temporary = temporary_path_for(destination)
        try:
            self._write_temporary_file(temporary, functools.partial(write_bytes, content))
            os.replace(temporary, destination)
        finally:
            remove_temporary_file(temporary)
        self._synchronise_directory(destination.parent)

    def _write_temporary_file(self, temporary: Path, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None]) -> int:
        flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL
        descriptor = os.open(temporary, flags, TEMPORARY_FILE_PERMISSIONS)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
            write_content(stream)
            written_size = stream.tell()
            stream.flush()
            flush_to_disk(stream.fileno())
        return written_size

    def _publish_without_overwriting(self, temporary: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
        try:
            os.link(temporary, destination)
        except FileExistsError:
            raise
        except OSError:
            # Volumes such as exFAT do not support hard links, so fall back to rename after checking again.
            if destination.exists():
                raise FileExistsError(f"Refusing to overwrite {destination}") from None
            os.rename(temporary, destination)

    def _synchronise_directory(self, directory: Path) -> None:
        try:
            descriptor = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
            try:
                flush_to_disk(descriptor)
            finally:
                os.close(descriptor)
        except OSError:
            LOGGER.warning("Could not synchronise the directory %s", directory)
```

- [ ] **Passo 7: Implementar o mínimo**

Crie `tests/fakes/scripted_file_writer.py` (dublê compartilhado com as Tarefas 18b e 18c; não é um módulo de teste). Ele só sobrescreve `write_new_file_from` e `replace_file`: o `write_new_file` herdado delega para `write_new_file_from`, então cada gravação é registrada uma única vez:

```python
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import BinaryIO

from digitalizadora.repositories.atomic_file_writer import AtomicFileWriter


class ScriptedFileWriter(AtomicFileWriter):
    """Writes for real, but the first write of each configured file name raises the configured error.

    written_file_names lists, in order, the names of the writes that succeeded (write_new_file,
    write_new_file_from and replace_file); a scripted failure writes nothing and is not listed.
    """

    def __init__(self, failures_by_file_name: Mapping[str, OSError]) -> None:
        self._pending_failures = dict(failures_by_file_name)
        self.written_file_names: list[str] = []

    def write_new_file_from(self, destination: Path, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None]) -> int:
        self._fail_once_when_scripted(destination)
        written_size = super().write_new_file_from(destination, write_content)
        self.written_file_names.append(destination.name)
        return written_size

    def replace_file(self, destination: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
        self._fail_once_when_scripted(destination)
        super().replace_file(destination, content)
        self.written_file_names.append(destination.name)

    def _fail_once_when_scripted(self, destination: Path) -> None:
        failure = self._pending_failures.pop(destination.name, None)
        if failure is not None:
            raise failure
```

- [ ] **Passo 11: Implementar o mínimo**

Em `src/digitalizadora/services/storage_guard_service.py`, substitua por inteiro `StorageGuardService` por (as duas conferências passam a usar o mesmo auxiliar privado `_ensure_free_space`; o `.part` e o nome final do PDF são o mesmo arquivo, por hard link, então o tamanho do arquivo não é contado em dobro):

```python
class StorageGuardService:
    def __init__(self, free_space_reader: Callable[[Path], int] = read_free_space_in_bytes) -> None:
        self._free_space_reader = free_space_reader

    def ensure_space_for_scan(self, folder: Path, settings: ScanSettings) -> None:
        self._ensure_free_space(folder, MINIMUM_FREE_SPACE_BYTES + SAFETY_MARGIN_PAGES * estimated_page_bytes(settings))

    def ensure_space_for_file(self, folder: Path, file_size_in_bytes: int) -> None:
        self._ensure_free_space(folder, MINIMUM_FREE_SPACE_BYTES + file_size_in_bytes)

    def estimate_pages_remaining(self, folder: Path, settings: ScanSettings) -> int:
        usable_space = self._free_space_reader(folder) - MINIMUM_FREE_SPACE_BYTES
        return max(0, usable_space // estimated_page_bytes(settings))

    def free_space_in_bytes(self, folder: Path) -> int:
        return self._free_space_reader(folder)

    def _ensure_free_space(self, folder: Path, required_space: int) -> None:
        free_space = self._free_space_reader(folder)
        if free_space < required_space:
            raise InsufficientStorageError(
                f"Only {free_space} bytes are free in {folder}; {required_space} bytes are required"
            )
```

Substitua o conteúdo inteiro de `src/digitalizadora/services/pdf_assembly_service.py` por (o `build_pdf` mantém o dpi fixo e o mesmo comportamento por fora; os dois métodos montam as opções no mesmo `_conversion_options`, com a função de layout sempre informada, porque o `img2pdf` a chama sem conferir se é `None`):

```python
import io
import os
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator, Sequence
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, BinaryIO

import img2pdf
from PIL import Image

from digitalizadora.domain.errors import ScanFailedError

PDF_CREATOR = "Digitalizadora"
DEFAULT_PDF_TITLE_TEMPLATE = "Digitalização {moment:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PdfDocumentSpecification:
    dots_per_inch: int
    title: str
    created_at: datetime


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PdfDocumentMetadata:
    title: str
    created_at: datetime


def _conversion_options(metadata: PdfDocumentMetadata, layout_function: Callable[..., Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "layout_fun": layout_function,
        "title": metadata.title,
        "creator": PDF_CREATOR,
        "creationdate": metadata.created_at,
        "moddate": metadata.created_at,
        "engine": img2pdf.Engine.pikepdf,
        "rotation": img2pdf.Rotation.ifvalid,
    }


@contextmanager
def _unreadable_images_as_scan_failures() -> Iterator[None]:
    try:
        yield
    except (img2pdf.ImageOpenError, Image.DecompressionBombError) as error:
        raise ScanFailedError("A scanned page could not be read as an image") from error


class PdfAssemblyService:
    def build_pdf(self, jpeg_pages: Sequence[bytes], specification: PdfDocumentSpecification) -> bytes:
        if not jpeg_pages:
            raise ScanFailedError("A PDF needs at least one page")
        fixed_resolution = (specification.dots_per_inch, specification.dots_per_inch)
        metadata = PdfDocumentMetadata(specification.title, specification.created_at)
        options = _conversion_options(metadata, img2pdf.get_fixed_dpi_layout_fun(fixed_resolution))
        with _unreadable_images_as_scan_failures():
            return img2pdf.convert(*[io.BytesIO(page) for page in jpeg_pages], **options)

    def write_pdf_at_embedded_resolutions(
        self, page_files: Sequence[Path], metadata: PdfDocumentMetadata, output_stream: BinaryIO
    ) -> None:
        """Each page keeps the physical size of its own JFIF density; pages are read by path, never joined.

        The paths go as bytes: img2pdf takes a path it cannot open as image data, and bytes then fail as
        an unreadable image (ScanFailedError) instead of a TypeError.
        """
        if not page_files:
            raise ScanFailedError("A PDF needs at least one page")
        options = _conversion_options(metadata, img2pdf.default_layout_fun)
        with _unreadable_images_as_scan_failures():
            img2pdf.convert(
                *[os.fsencode(page_file) for page_file in page_files], outputstream=output_stream, **options
            )
```

```python
def write_assembled_pdf(stream: BinaryIO) -> None:
    stream.write(ASSEMBLED_PDF)


class CountingPdfAssembly:
    """Stands in for the streamed assembly: writes the same PDF and counts how often it ran."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.call_count = 0

    def __call__(self, stream: BinaryIO) -> None:
        self.call_count += 1
        write_assembled_pdf(stream)


def build_document_pdf(
    document_name: str, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None] = write_assembled_pdf
) -> DocumentPdfToSave:
    return DocumentPdfToSave(write_content=write_content, created_at=FINALIZED_AT, document_name=document_name)


def fail_with_error_number(error_number: int) -> Callable[[BinaryIO], None]:
    def failing_assembly(stream: BinaryIO) -> None:
        raise OSError(error_number, os.strerror(error_number))

    return failing_assembly


def skip_on_a_case_sensitive_volume(folder: Path) -> None:
    probe = folder / "letter-case-probe"
    probe.write_bytes(b"")
    is_case_sensitive = not (folder / "LETTER-CASE-PROBE").exists()
    probe.unlink()
    if is_case_sensitive:
        pytest.skip("the volume is case-sensitive; the default APFS volume of macOS is not")


class StreamWriterThatSucceedsOnAttempt:
    def __init__(self, successful_attempt: int) -> None:
        self._successful_attempt = successful_attempt
        self.attempted_destinations: list[Path] = []

    def write_new_file_from(self, destination: Path, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None]) -> int:
        self.attempted_destinations.append(destination)
        if len(self.attempted_destinations) < self._successful_attempt:
            raise FileExistsError(destination)
        return len(ASSEMBLED_PDF)


class StreamWriterThatLosesTheFirstName:
    """Another 'process' takes the first chosen name while the PDF is being assembled."""

    def __init__(self, real_writer: AtomicFileWriter) -> None:
        self._real_writer = real_writer
        self._race_already_happened = False

    def write_new_file_from(self, destination: Path, write_content: Callable[[BinaryIO], None]) -> int:
        if self._race_already_happened:
            return self._real_writer.write_new_file_from(destination, write_content)
        self._race_already_happened = True

        def assemble_and_lose_the_name(stream: BinaryIO) -> None:
            write_content(stream)
            destination.write_bytes(b"written by another process")

        return self._real_writer.write_new_file_from(destination, assemble_and_lose_the_name)
```

Substitua o conteúdo inteiro de `src/digitalizadora/repositories/file_system_scan_output_repository.py` por (construtor e `save` com o mesmo comportamento; o laço de nomes vira o auxiliar privado único `_write_under_a_free_name`, que recebe os nomes candidatos e a gravação; o `save` continua gravando com `write_new_file`, por isso os dublês de hoje, que só têm esse método, continuam servindo):

```python
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Iterator
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from digitalizadora.domain.document_name_policy import FIRST_ATTEMPT_NUMBER, build_document_file_name
from digitalizadora.domain.document_pdf_to_save import DocumentPdfToSave
from digitalizadora.domain.encoded_scan import EncodedScan
from digitalizadora.domain.errors import OutputFolderUnavailableError
from digitalizadora.domain.output_format import OutputFormat
from digitalizadora.domain.ports import ApplicationSettingsRepository
from digitalizadora.domain.scan_file_naming_policy import ScanFileNamingPolicy
from digitalizadora.domain.scan_result import ScanResult
from digitalizadora.repositories.atomic_file_writer import AtomicFileWriter
from digitalizadora.repositories.output_folder_preparer import prepare_output_folder, translate_storage_error

MAXIMUM_NAME_ATTEMPTS = 1000


class FileSystemScanOutputRepository:
    def __init__(
        self,
        settings_repository: ApplicationSettingsRepository,
        naming_policy: ScanFileNamingPolicy,
        file_writer: AtomicFileWriter,
    ) -> None:
        self._settings_repository = settings_repository
        self._naming_policy = naming_policy
        self._file_writer = file_writer

    def output_folder(self) -> Path:
        return self._settings_repository.load().output_folder

    def ensure_output_folder_ready(self) -> None:
        prepare_output_folder(self.output_folder())

    def save(self, encoded_scan: EncodedScan) -> Path:
        folder = self.output_folder()
        candidate_names = self._sequence_file_names(folder, encoded_scan.created_at, encoded_scan.output_format)
        destination, _ = self._write_under_a_free_name(
            folder,
            candidate_names,
            lambda candidate: self._file_writer.write_new_file(candidate, encoded_scan.content),
        )
        return destination

    def save_document(self, document_pdf: DocumentPdfToSave) -> ScanResult:
        """Streams the PDF under the first free name; a name that already exists is skipped before assembling.

        Only a real race (another process creating the name during the assembly) assembles again.
        """
        folder = self.output_folder()
        destination, size_in_bytes = self._write_under_a_free_name(
            folder,
            self._document_file_names(folder, document_pdf),
            lambda candidate: self._file_writer.write_new_file_from(candidate, document_pdf.write_content),
        )
        return ScanResult(
            output_path=destination,
            output_format=OutputFormat.PDF,
            scanned_at=document_pdf.created_at,
            size_in_bytes=size_in_bytes,
        )

    def _document_file_names(self, folder: Path, document_pdf: DocumentPdfToSave) -> Iterator[str]:
        if not document_pdf.document_name:
            return self._sequence_file_names(folder, document_pdf.created_at, OutputFormat.PDF)
        self._prepare_folder(folder)
        attempt_numbers = range(FIRST_ATTEMPT_NUMBER, FIRST_ATTEMPT_NUMBER + MAXIMUM_NAME_ATTEMPTS)
        return (build_document_file_name(document_pdf.document_name, number) for number in attempt_numbers)

    def _sequence_file_names(self, folder: Path, created_at: datetime, output_format: OutputFormat) -> Iterator[str]:
        self._prepare_folder(folder)
        try:
            first_sequence_number = self._highest_sequence_number(folder, created_at) + 1
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_storage_error(error, f"Cannot use the output folder {folder}") from error
        sequence_numbers = range(first_sequence_number, first_sequence_number + MAXIMUM_NAME_ATTEMPTS)
        return (
            self._naming_policy.build_file_name(created_at, number, output_format) for number in sequence_numbers
        )

    def _prepare_folder(self, folder: Path) -> None:
        try:
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_storage_error(error, f"Cannot use the output folder {folder}") from error

    def _write_under_a_free_name[WrittenOutcome](
        self, folder: Path, candidate_names: Iterable[str], write_file: Callable[[Path], WrittenOutcome]
    ) -> tuple[Path, WrittenOutcome]:
        for candidate_name in candidate_names:
            destination = folder / candidate_name
            try:
                written_outcome = write_file(destination)
            except FileExistsError:
                continue
            except OSError as error:
                raise translate_storage_error(error, f"Cannot write {destination}") from error
            return destination, written_outcome
        raise OutputFolderUnavailableError(
            f"No free file name in {folder} after {MAXIMUM_NAME_ATTEMPTS} attempts"
        )

    def _highest_sequence_number(self, folder: Path, scanned_at: datetime) -> int:
        sequence_numbers = (
            self._naming_policy.extract_sequence_number(entry.name, scanned_at) for entry in folder.iterdir()
        )
        return max((number for number in sequence_numbers if number is not None), default=0)
```

Crie `src/digitalizadora/repositories/document_manifest_codec.py` (funções puras, sem I/O; qualquer violação das regras de leitura da seção 6.3 vira `UnreadableDraftError` com o motivo em inglês; as chaves desconhecidas são ignoradas, e as duas chaves de marca, quando ausentes, valem `null`):

```python
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from digitalizadora.domain.color_mode import ColorMode
from digitalizadora.domain.document_draft import DocumentDraft, DocumentPage, is_page_identifier
from digitalizadora.domain.errors import UnreadableDraftError
from digitalizadora.domain.output_format import OutputFormat
from digitalizadora.domain.scan_result import ScanResult

MANIFEST_FORMAT_VERSION = 1
MANIFEST_ENCODING = "utf-8"
MANIFEST_INDENTATION = 2
FORMAT_VERSION_KEY = "format_version"
NAME_KEY = "name"
CREATED_AT_KEY = "created_at"
PAGES_KEY = "pages"
PAGE_IDENTIFIER_KEY = "page_identifier"
SCANNED_AT_KEY = "scanned_at"
DOTS_PER_INCH_KEY = "dots_per_inch"
COLOR_MODE_KEY = "color_mode"
SIZE_IN_BYTES_KEY = "size_in_bytes"
FINALIZATION_STARTED_AT_KEY = "finalization_started_at"
FINISHED_DOCUMENT_KEY = "finished_document"
PATH_KEY = "path"
FINALIZED_AT_KEY = "finalized_at"
ALLOWED_DOTS_PER_INCH = range(1, 65536)
ALLOWED_SIZES_IN_BYTES = range(1, sys.maxsize)


def encode_manifest(draft: DocumentDraft) -> bytes:
    document = {
        FORMAT_VERSION_KEY: MANIFEST_FORMAT_VERSION,
        NAME_KEY: draft.name,
        CREATED_AT_KEY: draft.created_at.isoformat(),
        PAGES_KEY: [_encode_page(page) for page in draft.pages],
        FINALIZATION_STARTED_AT_KEY: _encode_optional_moment(draft.finalization_started_at),
        FINISHED_DOCUMENT_KEY: _encode_finished_document(draft.finished_document),
    }
    return json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, indent=MANIFEST_INDENTATION).encode(MANIFEST_ENCODING)


def decode_manifest(content: bytes) -> DocumentDraft:
    """Strict reading of format version 1: anything unexpected makes the whole manifest unreadable."""
    document = _parse_json_object(content)
    _check_format_version(_read_required(document, FORMAT_VERSION_KEY))
    return DocumentDraft(
        name=_read_text(document, NAME_KEY),
        created_at=_read_moment(document, CREATED_AT_KEY),
        pages=_read_pages(_read_required(document, PAGES_KEY)),
        finalization_started_at=_read_optional_moment(document, FINALIZATION_STARTED_AT_KEY),
        finished_document=_read_finished_document(document.get(FINISHED_DOCUMENT_KEY)),
    )


def _encode_page(page: DocumentPage) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        PAGE_IDENTIFIER_KEY: page.page_identifier,
        SCANNED_AT_KEY: page.scanned_at.isoformat(),
        DOTS_PER_INCH_KEY: page.dots_per_inch,
        COLOR_MODE_KEY: page.color_mode.value,
        SIZE_IN_BYTES_KEY: page.size_in_bytes,
    }


def _encode_optional_moment(moment: datetime | None) -> str | None:
    return None if moment is None else moment.isoformat()


def _encode_finished_document(finished_document: ScanResult | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if finished_document is None:
        return None
    return {
        PATH_KEY: str(finished_document.output_path),
        SIZE_IN_BYTES_KEY: finished_document.size_in_bytes,
        FINALIZED_AT_KEY: finished_document.scanned_at.isoformat(),
    }


def _parse_json_object(content: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        document = json.loads(content.decode(MANIFEST_ENCODING))
    except ValueError as error:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"The manifest is not valid UTF-8 JSON: {error}") from error
    return _as_json_object(document, "manifest")


def _as_json_object(value: object, description: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"The {description} is not a JSON object")
    return value


def _read_required(fields: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> object:
    if key not in fields:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"The manifest has no {key!r}")
    return fields[key]


def _is_whole_number(value: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)


def _check_format_version(value: object) -> None:
    if not _is_whole_number(value) or value != MANIFEST_FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"Unsupported manifest format version {value!r}")


def _read_text(fields: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> str:
    value = _read_required(fields, key)
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{key!r} is not text")
    return value


def _read_whole_number(fields: dict[str, Any], key: str, allowed_values: range) -> int:
    value = _read_required(fields, key)
    if not _is_whole_number(value) or value not in allowed_values:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{key!r} is not an allowed whole number: {value!r}")
    return value


def _read_moment(fields: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> datetime:
    return _parse_moment(_read_required(fields, key), key)


def _read_optional_moment(fields: dict[str, Any], key: str) -> datetime | None:
    value = fields.get(key)
    return None if value is None else _parse_moment(value, key)


def _parse_moment(value: object, key: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{key!r} is not an ISO 8601 text")
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{key!r} is not an ISO 8601 moment: {value!r}") from error
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{key!r} has no time zone: {value!r}")
    return moment


def _read_pages(value: object) -> tuple[DocumentPage, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"{PAGES_KEY!r} is not a list")
    pages = tuple(_read_page(_as_json_object(item, "page")) for item in value)
    page_identifiers = [page.page_identifier for page in pages]
    if len(set(page_identifiers)) != len(page_identifiers):
        raise UnreadableDraftError("The manifest lists the same page identifier twice")
    return pages


def _read_page(fields: dict[str, Any]) -> DocumentPage:
    page_identifier = _read_required(fields, PAGE_IDENTIFIER_KEY)
    if not is_page_identifier(page_identifier):
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"Invalid page identifier {page_identifier!r}")
    return DocumentPage(
        page_identifier=page_identifier,
        scanned_at=_read_moment(fields, SCANNED_AT_KEY),
        dots_per_inch=_read_whole_number(fields, DOTS_PER_INCH_KEY, ALLOWED_DOTS_PER_INCH),
        color_mode=_read_color_mode(fields),
        size_in_bytes=_read_whole_number(fields, SIZE_IN_BYTES_KEY, ALLOWED_SIZES_IN_BYTES),
    )


def _read_color_mode(fields: dict[str, Any]) -> ColorMode:
    value = _read_required(fields, COLOR_MODE_KEY)
    try:
        return ColorMode(value)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"Unknown color mode {value!r}") from error


def _read_finished_document(value: object) -> ScanResult | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    fields = _as_json_object(value, "finished document")
    output_path = Path(_read_text(fields, PATH_KEY))
    if not output_path.is_absolute():
        raise UnreadableDraftError(f"The finished document path {str(output_path)!r} is not absolute")
    return ScanResult(
        output_path=output_path,
        output_format=OutputFormat.PDF,
        scanned_at=_read_moment(fields, FINALIZED_AT_KEY),
        size_in_bytes=_read_whole_number(fields, SIZE_IN_BYTES_KEY, ALLOWED_SIZES_IN_BYTES),
    )
```

```python
PAGE_FILLER_BYTE = b"p"


def _write_draft_files(drafts_folder: Path, draft: DocumentDraft, page_contents: Sequence[bytes]) -> None:
    draft_folder = drafts_folder / CURRENT_DRAFT_FOLDER_NAME
    draft_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for page, page_content in zip(draft.pages, page_contents, strict=True):
        (draft_folder / page_file_name(page.page_identifier)).write_bytes(page_content)
        (draft_folder / thumbnail_file_name(page.page_identifier)).write_bytes(page_content)
    (draft_folder / MANIFEST_FILE_NAME).write_bytes(encode_manifest(draft))


def write_draft_folder(drafts_folder: Path, draft: DocumentDraft) -> None:
    """The manifest of the draft plus, for each page, a page file of the recorded size and a thumbnail."""
    _write_draft_files(drafts_folder, draft, [PAGE_FILLER_BYTE * page.size_in_bytes for page in draft.pages])


def seed_draft_folder(drafts_folder: Path, page_contents: Sequence[bytes]) -> DocumentDraft:
    """A draft whose pages hold the given contents (real JPEGs), in order; the thumbnail repeats the page."""
    pages = tuple(
        build_document_page(page_identifier_at(position), len(page_content))
        for position, page_content in enumerate(page_contents, FIRST_PAGE_POSITION)
    )
    draft = DocumentDraft(name="", created_at=DRAFT_CREATED_AT, pages=pages)
    _write_draft_files(drafts_folder, draft, page_contents)
    return draft
```

- [ ] **Passo 27: Implementar o mínimo**

Crie `src/digitalizadora/repositories/file_system_document_draft_repository.py` (as operações de inventário, de pôr de lado e de apagar o rascunho vêm no Ciclo 8; nenhum método decide o que fazer com uma sobra, o que é do `DocumentDraftStore` da Tarefa 18b):

```python
import fcntl
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import BinaryIO

from digitalizadora.domain.document_draft import DocumentDraft, DocumentPageFiles, is_page_identifier
from digitalizadora.domain.document_draft_reconciliation import (
    MANIFEST_FILE_NAME,
    page_file_name,
    thumbnail_file_name,
)
from digitalizadora.domain.errors import DigitalizadoraError, DraftFolderInUseError, as_draft_storage_error
from digitalizadora.domain.ports import Clock
from digitalizadora.repositories.atomic_file_writer import AtomicFileWriter
from digitalizadora.repositories.document_manifest_codec import decode_manifest, encode_manifest
from digitalizadora.repositories.output_folder_preparer import prepare_output_folder, translate_storage_error

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CURRENT_DRAFT_FOLDER_NAME = "current"
OWNER_LOCK_FILE_NAME = ".owner-lock"
OWNER_LOCK_OPEN_MODE = "a+b"


def translate_draft_storage_error(error: OSError, description: str) -> DigitalizadoraError:
    """The draft lives on the internal disk: full disk → insufficient_draft_storage, anything else unavailable."""
    return as_draft_storage_error(translate_storage_error(error, description))


class FileSystemDocumentDraftRepository:
    def __init__(self, drafts_folder: Path, file_writer: AtomicFileWriter, clock: Clock) -> None:
        self._drafts_folder = drafts_folder
        self._draft_folder = drafts_folder / CURRENT_DRAFT_FOLDER_NAME
        self._file_writer = file_writer
        self._clock = clock
        self._owner_lock_file: BinaryIO | None = None

    def storage_folder(self) -> Path:
        return self._drafts_folder

    def claim_exclusive_access(self) -> None:
        """Takes the owner lock and keeps its file open while this repository exists (R12).

        The process that ends releases the lock, so a crash never leaves the folder locked.
        """
        if self._owner_lock_file is not None:
            return
        lock_path = self._drafts_folder / OWNER_LOCK_FILE_NAME
        try:
            self._drafts_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            owner_lock_file = lock_path.open(OWNER_LOCK_OPEN_MODE)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot open {lock_path}") from error
        try:
            fcntl.flock(owner_lock_file, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as error:
            owner_lock_file.close()
            raise DraftFolderInUseError(f"Another process already writes in {self._drafts_folder}") from error
        except OSError as error:
            owner_lock_file.close()
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot lock {lock_path}") from error
        self._owner_lock_file = owner_lock_file

    def ensure_storage_folder_ready(self) -> None:
        try:
            prepare_output_folder(self._drafts_folder)
        except DigitalizadoraError as error:
            raise as_draft_storage_error(error) from error

    def load_manifest(self) -> DocumentDraft | None:
        try:
            content = self._manifest_path().read_bytes()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, "Cannot read the draft manifest") from error
        return decode_manifest(content)

    def save_manifest(self, draft: DocumentDraft) -> None:
        try:
            self._file_writer.replace_file(self._manifest_path(), encode_manifest(draft))
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, "Cannot save the draft manifest") from error

    def ensure_draft_folder_exists(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._draft_folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot create {self._draft_folder}") from error

    def write_page_files(self, page_files: DocumentPageFiles) -> None:
        """The page first, then its thumbnail; a thumbnail that fails takes the new page away with it."""
        page_path = self.page_file_path(page_files.page_identifier)
        try:
            self._file_writer.write_new_file(page_path, page_files.jpeg_content)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot write {page_path.name}") from error
        thumbnail_path = self._thumbnail_path(page_files.page_identifier)
        try:
            self._file_writer.write_new_file(thumbnail_path, page_files.thumbnail_jpeg)
        except OSError as error:
            self._delete_quietly(page_path)
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot write {thumbnail_path.name}") from error

    def page_file_path(self, page_identifier: str) -> Path:
        return self._draft_folder / page_file_name(page_identifier)

    def page_file_size(self, page_identifier: str) -> int | None:
        page_path = self.page_file_path(page_identifier)
        try:
            return page_path.stat().st_size
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot examine {page_path.name}") from error

    def read_thumbnail(self, page_identifier: str) -> bytes | None:
        if not is_page_identifier(page_identifier):
            return None
        thumbnail_path = self._thumbnail_path(page_identifier)
        try:
            return thumbnail_path.read_bytes()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        except OSError:
            LOGGER.warning("Could not read the thumbnail %s", thumbnail_path, exc_info=True)
            return None

    def delete_page_files(self, page_identifier: str) -> None:
        self._delete_quietly(self.page_file_path(page_identifier))
        self._delete_quietly(self._thumbnail_path(page_identifier))

    def finished_document_exists(self, finished_document_path: Path) -> bool:
        """Only a file confirmed now counts: a missing disk or a closed folder answers False (R15)."""
        try:
            return finished_document_path.is_file()
        except OSError:
            return False

    def _manifest_path(self) -> Path:
        return self._draft_folder / MANIFEST_FILE_NAME

    def _thumbnail_path(self, page_identifier: str) -> Path:
        return self._draft_folder / thumbnail_file_name(page_identifier)

    def _delete_quietly(self, file_path: Path) -> None:
        try:
            file_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            LOGGER.warning("Could not delete %s", file_path)
```

```python
def test_delete_draft_makes_the_manifest_deletion_durable_before_deleting_anything_else(drafts_folder, monkeypatch):
    write_draft_folder(drafts_folder, build_document_draft(2))
    events: list[str] = []
    original_unlink = Path.unlink
    original_fcntl = fcntl.fcntl

    def recording_unlink(self: Path, **options: object) -> None:
        events.append(self.name)
        original_unlink(self, **options)

    def recording_fcntl(descriptor: int, command: int) -> int:
        if command == fcntl.F_FULLFSYNC:
            events.append("folder flushed")
        return original_fcntl(descriptor, command)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "unlink", recording_unlink)
    monkeypatch.setattr(fcntl, "fcntl", recording_fcntl)

    build_repository(drafts_folder).delete_draft()

    assert events == [
        "manifest.json",
        "folder flushed",
        FIRST_PAGE_FILE_NAME,
        f"page-{SECOND_PAGE_IDENTIFIER}.jpg",
        FIRST_THUMBNAIL_FILE_NAME,
        f"thumbnail-{SECOND_PAGE_IDENTIFIER}.jpg",
    ]
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/file_system_document_draft_repository.py`, logo depois da constante `OWNER_LOCK_OPEN_MODE`, acrescente (os nomes temporários são os do `AtomicFileWriter`, `.<nome>.<pid>-<token>.part`, e os da prova de escrita do `prepare_output_folder`; qualquer outro nome fora de `page-`, `thumbnail-` e `manifest.json` é desconhecido e nunca é apagado nem movido, R14):

```python
SET_ASIDE_FOLDER_PREFIX = "set-aside-"
SET_ASIDE_MOMENT_FORMAT = "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"
SET_ASIDE_TOKEN_SIZE_IN_BYTES = 4
HEXADECIMAL_DIGITS_PER_BYTE = 2
TEMPORARY_FILE_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(
    rf"{re.escape(TEMPORARY_FILE_PREFIX)}.+\.[0-9]+-"
    rf"[0-9a-f]{{{HEXADECIMAL_DIGITS_PER_BYTE * TEMPORARY_TOKEN_SIZE_IN_BYTES}}}"
    rf"{re.escape(TEMPORARY_FILE_SUFFIX)}"
)
FILE_NAMES_THAT_ARE_NOT_FILES = frozenset({"", ".", ".."})


def _page_identifier_in(file_name: str, prefix: str) -> str | None:
    if not (file_name.startswith(prefix) and file_name.endswith(JPEG_FILE_SUFFIX)):
        return None
    candidate = file_name[len(prefix) : -len(JPEG_FILE_SUFFIX)]
    return candidate if is_page_identifier(candidate) else None


def _is_temporary_file_name(file_name: str) -> bool:
    return file_name.startswith(WRITE_PROBE_FILE_PREFIX) or TEMPORARY_FILE_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(file_name) is not None


def _build_inventory(entries: Iterable[os.DirEntry]) -> DraftFileInventory:
    page_file_sizes: dict[str, int] = {}
    thumbnail_identifiers: set[str] = set()
    temporary_file_names: set[str] = set()
    unknown_file_names: set[str] = set()
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.name == MANIFEST_FILE_NAME:
            continue
        if not entry.is_file(follow_symlinks=False):
            unknown_file_names.add(entry.name)
        elif page_identifier := _page_identifier_in(entry.name, PAGE_FILE_PREFIX):
            try:
                page_file_sizes[page_identifier] = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_size
            except FileNotFoundError:  # vanished after the listing: a missing page, not a missing folder
                continue
        elif thumbnail_identifier := _page_identifier_in(entry.name, THUMBNAIL_FILE_PREFIX):
            thumbnail_identifiers.add(thumbnail_identifier)
        elif _is_temporary_file_name(entry.name):
            temporary_file_names.add(entry.name)
        else:
            unknown_file_names.add(entry.name)
    return DraftFileInventory(
        page_file_sizes=page_file_sizes,
        thumbnail_identifiers=frozenset(thumbnail_identifiers),
        temporary_file_names=frozenset(temporary_file_names),
        unknown_file_names=frozenset(unknown_file_names),
    )


def _plain_file_names(file_names: Iterable[str]) -> Iterator[str]:
    """Only simple names inside the draft folder: a separator, "." or ".." is refused with a warning."""
    for file_name in file_names:
        if file_name in FILE_NAMES_THAT_ARE_NOT_FILES or os.sep in file_name:
            LOGGER.warning("Refusing to touch %r: it is not a plain file name of the draft folder", file_name)
            continue
        yield file_name
```

Em `src/digitalizadora/repositories/file_system_document_draft_repository.py`, acrescente ao final da classe `FileSystemDocumentDraftRepository` (depois do último método; as reticências `...` representam o resto da classe):

```python
class FileSystemDocumentDraftRepository:
    ...
    def take_inventory(self) -> DraftFileInventory:
        """Classifies the names in current/; a missing folder is an empty inventory."""
        try:
            directory = os.scandir(self._draft_folder)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return _build_inventory([])
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot list {self._draft_folder}") from error
        try:
            with directory as entries:
                return _build_inventory(entries)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot list {self._draft_folder}") from error

    def delete_files(self, file_names: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        for file_name in _plain_file_names(file_names):
            self._delete_quietly(self._draft_folder / file_name)

    def set_aside_files(self, file_names: Sequence[str]) -> Path:
        set_aside_folder = self._new_set_aside_folder()
        try:
            set_aside_folder.mkdir()
            for file_name in _plain_file_names(file_names):
                os.rename(self._draft_folder / file_name, set_aside_folder / file_name)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot set files aside in {set_aside_folder}") from error
        return set_aside_folder

    def set_aside_draft_folder(self) -> Path | None:
        set_aside_folder = self._new_set_aside_folder()
        try:
            os.rename(self._draft_folder, set_aside_folder)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, f"Cannot set {self._draft_folder} aside") from error
        return set_aside_folder

    def delete_draft(self) -> None:
        """The manifest first (a failure to delete it raises), then only the known files (R14)."""
        self._delete_manifest()
        try:
            known_file_names = self.take_inventory().known_file_names
        except DigitalizadoraError:
            LOGGER.warning("Could not list the draft folder after deleting its manifest", exc_info=True)
            return
        self.delete_files(known_file_names)
        self._remove_draft_folder_when_empty()

    def _delete_manifest(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._manifest_path().unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError as error:
            raise translate_draft_storage_error(error, "Cannot delete the draft manifest") from error
        try:
            self._synchronise_draft_folder()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return
        except OSError:
            LOGGER.warning("Could not synchronise %s after deleting its manifest", self._draft_folder, exc_info=True)

    def _synchronise_draft_folder(self) -> None:
        descriptor = os.open(self._draft_folder, os.O_RDONLY)
        try:
            flush_to_disk(descriptor)
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)

    def _remove_draft_folder_when_empty(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._draft_folder.rmdir()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno != errno.ENOTEMPTY:
                LOGGER.warning("Could not remove the empty draft folder %s: %s", self._draft_folder, error)

    def _new_set_aside_folder(self) -> Path:
        moment_text = self._clock.now().strftime(SET_ASIDE_MOMENT_FORMAT)
        token = secrets.token_hex(SET_ASIDE_TOKEN_SIZE_IN_BYTES)
        return self._drafts_folder / f"{SET_ASIDE_FOLDER_PREFIX}{moment_text}-{token}"
```

### Task 18a: Sequência única de digitalização para a página do documento

**Objetivo:** Refatorar o `ScanService` para que o modo rápido e a página do documento usem a mesma sequência (`_capture_and_store`), o mesmo tratamento de falhas (`_recording_failures`) e o mesmo `ScanProgressTracker`, com um destino trocável (`ScanDestination`), sem mudar nenhum teste do modo rápido. A página do documento ganha a marca de conclusão própria (`mark_page_added`), que conta o scan sem tocar no painel "Último arquivo" do modo rápido.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/digitalizadora/services/scan_destination.py`
- Create: `tests/fakes/observing_scanner_gateway.py`
- Create: `tests/fakes/recording_scan_destinations.py`
- Modify: `src/digitalizadora/services/scan_progress_tracker.py`
- Modify: `src/digitalizadora/services/scan_service.py`
- Test: `tests/services/test_scan_service_document_page.py`
- Modify: `tests/services/test_scan_progress_tracker.py` (só acréscimos)
- Modify: `tests/services/test_scan_service.py` (só os imports: os dois dublês saem do arquivo para `tests/fakes/`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (Task 2): `ScanRequest`, `ScanJob`, `ScannedImage`, `ScanResult`, `StoredScan`, `ScanPhase`, `ScanProgressSnapshot`, `ScanSettings`, `ScannerCapabilities`, `OutputFormat`, `ScanPreset` e os erros de `digitalizadora.domain.errors`.
- Consumes (Task 8): `ScanOutputService` com `ensure_capacity(request)` e `store(scanned_image, job) -> StoredScan`, que já satisfaz `ScanDestination[StoredScan]` sem nenhuma mudança.
- Consumes (Task 10): `ScanProgressTracker(clock)` com `begin_scan`, `mark_scanning`, `mark_saving`, `mark_completed`, `mark_failed`, `snapshot` e `last_thumbnail_jpeg`; `ScanService(gateway_provider, scan_output_service, progress_tracker)` com `is_scan_in_progress()` e `scan_one_file(request)`; os dublês `ScriptedScannerGateway`, `FixedGatewayProvider`, `build_sample_capabilities`, `FixedClock` e `tests.fakes.stored_scans` (`STORED_SCAN_SCANNED_AT`, `STORED_SCAN_OUTPUT_PATH`, `SAMPLE_THUMBNAIL_JPEG`, `build_stored_scan`).
- Consumes (Task 15): `DocumentPage` de `digitalizadora.domain.document_draft`; `DraftStorageUnavailableError` e `InsufficientDraftStorageError`; `tests.fakes.document_drafts.build_document_page(page_identifier)` e `page_identifier_at(position)`.
- Produces (design 6.4): `ScanDestination[StoredOutcome]` (Protocol de serviço em `digitalizadora.services.scan_destination`, com `ensure_capacity(request) -> None` e `store(scanned_image, job) -> StoredOutcome`, os dois chamados em thread); `ScanProgressTracker.mark_page_added()`; `ScanService.scan_document_page(request, page_capture) -> DocumentPage`; os auxiliares privados `ScanService._capture_and_store(job, destination)` e `ScanService._recording_failures()`.
- Produces (apoio de teste, design 6.8): `tests.fakes.observing_scanner_gateway.ObservingScriptedScannerGateway(capabilities, scan_outcomes, progress_tracker)` (com `scan_started`, `release_scan`, `hold_scans_open()` e `phase_during_scan`); `tests.fakes.recording_scan_destinations.RecordingScanOutputService(progress_tracker)` (fases, threads, `capacity_failure`, `store_failure`, `capacity_requests`, `stored_jobs`; devolve um `StoredScan`) e `RecordingDocumentPageDestination(progress_tracker, stored_page)`, com o mesmo registro e um `store` que devolve o `DocumentPage` recebido. A Tarefa 19 usa `ObservingScriptedScannerGateway` nos testes de concorrência.

**Notas da tarefa**
- Uma sequência só: `_capture_and_store` é o corpo de hoje de `_scan_and_store` sem a marca de conclusão: `ensure_capacity` em thread, `acquire_gateway`, `mark_scanning`, `scan_page(job.request.settings)`, `mark_saving` e `store` em thread. Cada método público faz `begin_scan` **fora** do `with` e antes do primeiro `await` (um segundo pedido recebe `ScanAlreadyRunningError` sem mexer no estado do que está em curso), roda a sequência dentro de `with self._recording_failures():` e chama a sua marca de conclusão ainda dentro do `with`, como hoje a `mark_completed` fica dentro do `try`. Como o tracker é o mesmo, uma página do documento e um scan rápido nunca rodam ao mesmo tempo (o mesmo `409 scan_already_running` da M9).
- `_recording_failures` é um `contextlib.contextmanager` com o tratamento de hoje: `DigitalizadoraError` grava o próprio código; outra exceção vai para o log com o traceback (`logger.exception`) e grava `unexpected_error`; nos dois casos a exceção sobe de novo. `asyncio.CancelledError` não é `Exception` e continua passando direto, como hoje.
- `mark_page_added` (6.4): fase `IDLE` e `scans_completed + 1` numa única atribuição do retrato, como as outras transições. `last_result`, `last_error_code` (já limpo pelo `begin_scan`) e a miniatura **não** mudam: o painel do modo rápido continua mostrando o último arquivo, e a página do documento chega à interface pelo resumo `document` de `/api/state` (R8, Tarefa 20).
- O construtor do `ScanService` mantém os três parâmetros e o nome `scan_output_service`; só a anotação passa de `ScanOutputService` para `ScanDestination[StoredScan]`, para o serviço depender do Protocol e não da classe concreta. A raiz de composição (Tarefa 13) não muda: continua passando o `ScanOutputService`.
- `scan_document_page` recebe o destino por parâmetro (é o mesmo método genérico com outro destino); só a raiz o chama assim, uma vez, com `functools.partial` (Tarefa 20), e o `DocumentDraftService` (Tarefa 19) recebe a função pronta.
- Os dois dublês de `tests/services/test_scan_service.py` vão para `tests/fakes/` sem mudança de comportamento, porque as Tarefas 18a e 19 também os usam; o arquivo de teste troca só o bloco de cima (imports, constantes e `build_failed_snapshot`, que não mudam) e perde as duas classes. `RecordingScanOutputService` ganha um auxiliar privado `_record_store(job)` com o registro que o `store` de hoje já fazia, para que `RecordingDocumentPageDestination` registre igual.
- Os testes novos cobrem só o que difere do modo rápido: o destino recebido, a marca de conclusão e o bloqueio mútuo. A ordem das fases, as threads e cada erro do gateway já estão cobertos por `test_scan_service.py`, que passa a exercitar a sequência refatorada.

Cobertura do Review Focus: modo (3) do design (pedidos concorrentes): segunda página durante uma página → `ScanAlreadyRunningError` sem mexer no estado e sem chamar o destino de novo; scan rápido recusado durante uma página e página recusada durante um scan rápido. Modo (5) (falta de espaço ou pasta ausente): falha de capacidade do destino (`InsufficientDraftStorageError`) e de gravação (`DraftStorageUnavailableError`) gravam o próprio código e não deixam a fase presa.

```python
import asyncio

from digitalizadora.domain.scan_progress import ScanPhase
from digitalizadora.domain.scan_settings import ScanSettings
from digitalizadora.domain.scanned_image import ScannedImage
from digitalizadora.domain.scanner_capabilities import ScannerCapabilities
from digitalizadora.services.scan_progress_tracker import ScanProgressTracker
from tests.fakes.scripted_scanner_gateway import ScriptedScannerGateway


class ObservingScriptedScannerGateway(ScriptedScannerGateway):
    """Scripted gateway that can hold a scan open and reports the phase it ran in."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        capabilities: ScannerCapabilities,
        scan_outcomes: list[ScannedImage | Exception],
        progress_tracker: ScanProgressTracker,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(capabilities, scan_outcomes)
        self._progress_tracker = progress_tracker
        self.scan_started = asyncio.Event()
        self.release_scan = asyncio.Event()
        self.release_scan.set()
        self.phase_during_scan: ScanPhase | None = None

    def hold_scans_open(self) -> None:
        self.release_scan.clear()

    async def scan_page(self, settings: ScanSettings) -> ScannedImage:
        self.phase_during_scan = self._progress_tracker.snapshot().phase
        self.scan_started.set()
        await self.release_scan.wait()
        return await super().scan_page(settings)
```
