def read_static_file(file_name: str) -> str:
    return (STATIC_DIRECTORY / file_name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def find_identifiers_used_by_script(script: str) -> set[str]:
    used_identifiers: set[str] = set()
    for pattern in SCRIPT_IDENTIFIER_PATTERNS:
        used_identifiers.update(pattern.findall(script))
    return used_identifiers


def find_elements_used_by_the_document_panel() -> set[str]:
    script = read_static_file("document-panel.js")
    used_elements = set(PANEL_ELEMENT_PATTERN.findall(script))
    for destructured_names in PANEL_DESTRUCTURED_ELEMENTS_PATTERN.findall(script):
        used_elements.update(name.strip() for name in destructured_names.split(",") if name.strip())
    return used_elements


@pytest.mark.parametrize("file_name", STATIC_FILE_NAMES)
def test_static_file_exists(file_name: str) -> None:
    assert (STATIC_DIRECTORY / file_name).is_file()


def test_script_uses_element_identifiers() -> None:
    assert find_identifiers_used_by_script(read_static_file("application.js"))


def test_every_element_identifier_used_by_script_exists_in_page() -> None:
    used_identifiers = find_identifiers_used_by_script(read_static_file("application.js"))
    declared_identifiers = set(PAGE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.findall(read_static_file("index.html")))
    assert used_identifiers - declared_identifiers == set()


def test_document_panel_uses_page_elements() -> None:
    assert find_elements_used_by_the_document_panel()


def test_every_element_used_by_the_document_panel_is_collected_by_the_page() -> None:
    collected_elements = set(COLLECTED_ELEMENT_PATTERN.findall(read_static_file("application.js")))
    assert find_elements_used_by_the_document_panel() - collected_elements == set()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("element_identifier", DOCUMENT_ELEMENT_IDENTIFIERS)
def test_page_declares_document_mode_element(element_identifier: str) -> None:
    assert element_identifier in PAGE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.findall(read_static_file("index.html"))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("required_text", ["X-Requested-With", "digitalizadora"])
def test_script_sends_required_header(required_text: str) -> None:
    assert required_text in read_static_file("application.js")


def test_page_declares_brazilian_portuguese_language() -> None:
    assert re.search(r'<html[^>]*\blang="pt-BR"', read_static_file("index.html"))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("file_name", STATIC_FILE_NAMES)
def test_static_file_has_no_external_address(file_name: str) -> None:
    assert EXTERNAL_ADDRESS_PATTERN.search(read_static_file(file_name)) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("file_name", SCRIPT_FILE_NAMES)
def test_script_has_no_console_log(file_name: str) -> None:
    assert "console.log" not in read_static_file(file_name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "served_path", ["/static/application.css", *(f"/static/{file_name}" for file_name in SCRIPT_FILE_NAMES)]
)
def test_page_references_files_served_by_static_route(served_path: str) -> None:
    assert served_path in read_static_file("index.html")


def test_page_loads_the_trigger_policy_before_the_application_script() -> None:
    page = read_static_file("index.html")
    assert page.index(POLICY_SCRIPT_PATH) < page.index(APPLICATION_SCRIPT_PATH)


def test_page_loads_the_five_scripts_in_dependency_order() -> None:
    assert SCRIPT_SOURCE_PATTERN.findall(read_static_file("index.html")) == SCRIPT_FILE_NAMES


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "api_path", ["/api/settings", "/api/state", "/api/printer", "/api/scans", "/api/document/pages"]
)
def test_script_calls_api_path(api_path: str) -> None:
    assert api_path in read_static_file("application.js")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "path_text", ['"/api/document"', "/pages", "/last", "/page-order", "/name", "/finalize", "/thumbnail"]
)
def test_document_panel_calls_document_route(path_text: str) -> None:
    assert path_text in read_static_file("document-panel.js")


def test_script_defines_byte_count_formatter() -> None:
    assert "function format_byte_count(size_in_bytes)" in read_static_file("application.js")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("option_value", ["pdf", "jpg", "document", "document_economy", "photo", "single"])
def test_page_offers_every_format_preset_and_mode(option_value: str) -> None:
    assert f'value="{option_value}"' in read_static_file("index.html")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "option_text", ["Texto (300 dpi, cor)", "Texto econômico (200 dpi, cinza)", "Foto (600 dpi, cor)"]
)
def test_quality_options_use_the_new_names(option_text: str) -> None:
    assert f">{option_text}</option>" in read_static_file("index.html")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("printer_changing_path", ["/api/printer/refresh", "/api/printer/address"])
def test_script_never_changes_the_printer_connection(printer_changing_path: str) -> None:
    # The page has no refresh or address control, so nothing can swap the printer in the middle of a scan.
    assert printer_changing_path not in read_static_file("application.js")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", ["alert", "status"])
def test_page_declares_accessible_region(role: str) -> None:
    assert f'role="{role}"' in read_static_file("index.html")


def test_document_name_field_has_no_length_limit() -> None:
    # The server refuses a name that is too long with a clear message (R4); a maxlength would cut it silently.
    assert re.search(r'<input id="document-name-input"[^>]*\bmaxlength', read_static_file("index.html")) is None

:root {

  --color-surface: #ffffff;
  --color-text: #1b1f24;
  --color-text-muted: #4a5460;

* {

}

}

}

}

  background: var(--color-surface);

}

.printer-chip[data-printer-condition="ready"] {
  border-color: var(--color-success-text);
  background: var(--color-success-background);

}

}

.printer-chip[data-printer-condition="missing"] {

}

select,

.status-line {

  gap: var(--size-gutter);
  align-items: start;
  padding: var(--size-gutter);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-surface);
}

.last-scan-thumbnail {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
}

.last-scan-details {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.last-scan-details dt {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.last-scan-details dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.session-counter {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  text-align: center;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.document-pending-notice {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-surface);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.document-section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: var(--size-gutter);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-surface);
}

.document-notice,
.document-finished-message,
.document-empty-message,
.document-summary {
  margin: 0;
}

.document-notice {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-warning-background);
  color: var(--color-warning-text);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.document-finished-message {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-success-background);
  color: var(--color-success-text);
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.document-empty-message {
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.document-page-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(9rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.page-tile {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.375rem;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-background);
  cursor: grab;
}

.page-tile.is-drop-before {
  box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--color-accent);
}

.page-tile.is-drop-after {
  box-shadow: inset -4px 0 0 var(--color-accent);
}

.page-tile.is-damaged {
  border-color: var(--color-error-border);
  background: var(--color-error-background);
}

.page-thumbnail,
.page-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
  background: var(--color-surface);
}

.page-placeholder {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.page-number {
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

.page-actions {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.page-actions button {
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  padding: 0.25rem;
}

.page-actions .page-move-to {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.document-bar {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.document-summary {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.document-actions,
.dialog-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.document-actions kbd {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.finalize-button {
  border-color: var(--color-accent);
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-accent-text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.finalize-button kbd {
  color: inherit;
}

.page-dialog {
  max-width: min(28rem, calc(100vw - 2 * var(--size-gutter)));
  padding: 1.25rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-control);
  background: var(--color-surface);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.page-dialog::backdrop {
  background: rgb(0 0 0 / 45%);
}

.dialog-text {
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.noscript-message {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
}

@media (max-width: 30rem) {
  .last-scan-panel {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

Crie `tests/web/fake-browser.js` (o falso navegador compartilhado pelos dois harnesses de página; não é um módulo de teste):

```javascript
"use strict";

// A small fake browser for the Node harnesses: a DOM built from the elements with an id in index.html (keeping which
// of them contains which), elements created by the scripts, key and click dispatch with capture and bubbling, the
// native button activation by Enter and Space, a modal <dialog>, focus with blur, timers that only run when a test
// asks, a localStorage (or one that refuses to work), and a fetch that records each request and answers what the
// scenario scripted.

const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const vm = require("node:vm");

const STATIC_DIRECTORY = path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "..", "src", "digitalizadora", "web", "static");
const PAGE_SCRIPT_FILE_NAMES = [
  "scan-trigger-policy.js",
  "error-banner.js",
  "document-page-policy.js",
  "document-panel.js",
  "application.js",
];
const TAG_PATTERN = /<(\/?)([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\b([^>]*)>/g;
const IDENTIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_PATTERN = /\bid="([^"]+)"/;
const VALUE_ATTRIBUTE_PATTERN = /\bvalue="([^"]*)"/;
const VOID_TAG_NAMES = new Set(["meta", "link", "input", "img", "br", "hr"]);
const DIALOG_TAG_NAME = "DIALOG";
const BUTTON_TAG_NAME = "BUTTON";
const FLUSH_ROUNDS = 10;
const ENTER_KEY_CODES = ["Enter", "NumpadEnter"];
const SPACE_KEY_CODE = "Space";
const ESCAPE_KEY_CODE = "Escape";
const KEYBOARD_CLICK_DETAIL = 0;
const POINTER_CLICK_DETAIL = 1;
const DEFAULT_TILE_BOX = Object.freeze({ left: 0, top: 0, width: 100, height: 140 });

class FakeClassList {
  constructor() {
    this.names = new Set();
  }

  add(...class_names) {
    class_names.forEach((class_name) => this.names.add(class_name));
  }

  remove(...class_names) {
    class_names.forEach((class_name) => this.names.delete(class_name));
  }

  toggle(class_name, should_have) {
    const will_have = should_have ?? !this.names.has(class_name);
    if (will_have) {
      this.names.add(class_name);
    } else {
      this.names.delete(class_name);
    }
    return will_have;
  }

  contains(class_name) {
    return this.names.has(class_name);
  }
}

function build_event(event_type, properties) {
  return {
    type: event_type,
    bubbles: true,
    detail: 0,
    repeat: false,
    code: "",
    clientX: 0,
    defaultPrevented: false,
    propagation_stopped: false,
    preventDefault() {
      this.defaultPrevented = true;
    },
    stopPropagation() {
      this.propagation_stopped = true;
    },
    ...properties,
  };
}

class FakeEventTarget {
  constructor() {
    this.registered_listeners = [];
  }

  addEventListener(event_type, listener, options) {
    const capture = options === true || options?.capture === true;
    const once = options?.once === true;
    this.registered_listeners.push({ event_type, listener, capture, once });
  }

  run_listeners(event, phase_filter) {
    for (const registration of [...this.registered_listeners]) {
      if (registration.event_type !== event.type || !phase_filter(registration)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (registration.once) {
        this.registered_listeners = this.registered_listeners.filter((candidate) => candidate !== registration);
      }
      registration.listener(event);
      if (event.propagation_stopped) {
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  count_listeners(event_type) {
    return this.registered_listeners.filter((registration) => registration.event_type === event_type).length;
  }
}

class FakeElement extends FakeEventTarget {
  constructor(tag_name, page_document) {
    super();
    this.tagName = tag_name;
    this.page_document = page_document;
    this.parent = null;
    this.children = [];
    this.dataset = {};
    this.attributes = {};
    this.classList = new FakeClassList();
    this.textContent = "";
    this.hidden = false;
    this.disabled = false;
    this.value = "";
    this.checked = false;
    this.title = "";
    this.src = "";
    this.alt = "";
    this.draggable = false;
    this.isContentEditable = false;
    this.is_text_selected = false;
    this.box = DEFAULT_TILE_BOX;
  }

  setAttribute(attribute_name, attribute_value) {
    this.attributes[attribute_name] = String(attribute_value);
  }

  getAttribute(attribute_name) {
    return this.attributes[attribute_name] ?? null;
  }

  focus() {
    // Browsers never focus a disabled control.
    if (!this.disabled) {
      this.page_document.move_focus_to(this);
    }
  }

  blur() {
    if (this.page_document.activeElement === this) {
      this.page_document.move_focus_to(this.page_document.body);
    }
  }

  select() {
    this.is_text_selected = true;
  }

  append(...child_elements) {
    child_elements.forEach((child_element) => {
      child_element.parent = this;
      this.children.push(child_element);
    });
  }

  replaceChildren(...child_elements) {
    this.children.forEach((child_element) => {
      child_element.parent = null;
    });
    this.children = [];
    this.append(...child_elements);
  }

  contains(other_element) {
    for (let node = other_element; node !== null; node = node.parent) {
      if (node === this) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  getBoundingClientRect() {
    return this.box;
  }
}

class FakeDialog extends FakeElement {
  constructor(page_document) {
    super(DIALOG_TAG_NAME, page_document);
    this.open = false;
    this.returnValue = "";
  }

  showModal() {
    this.open = true;
  }

  close(return_value) {
    if (!this.open) {
      return;
    }
    this.open = false;
    if (return_value !== undefined) {
      this.returnValue = return_value;
    }
    this.run_listeners(build_event("close", { target: this, bubbles: false }), () => true);
  }
}

class FakeDocument extends FakeEventTarget {
  constructor(page_markup) {
    super();
    this.body = new FakeElement("BODY", this);
    this.activeElement = this.body;
    this.elements = new Map();
    this.build_elements(page_markup);
  }

  build_elements(page_markup) {
    const open_elements = [];
    for (const [, closing_slash, tag_name, attributes] of page_markup.matchAll(TAG_PATTERN)) {
      if (closing_slash === "/") {
        open_elements.pop();
        continue;
      }
      const identifier_match = IDENTIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_PATTERN.exec(attributes);
      const nearest_parent = [...open_elements].reverse().find((element) => element !== null) ?? null;
      let element = null;
      if (identifier_match !== null) {
        element = this.createElement(tag_name);
        element.value = VALUE_ATTRIBUTE_PATTERN.exec(attributes)?.[1] ?? "";
        if (nearest_parent !== null) {
          nearest_parent.append(element);
        }
        this.elements.set(identifier_match[1], element);
      }
      if (!VOID_TAG_NAMES.has(tag_name)) {
        open_elements.push(element);
      }
    }
  }

  createElement(tag_name) {
    const upper_tag_name = tag_name.toUpperCase();
    return upper_tag_name === DIALOG_TAG_NAME ? new FakeDialog(this) : new FakeElement(upper_tag_name, this);
  }

  getElementById(element_identifier) {
    return this.elements.get(element_identifier) ?? null;
  }

  move_focus_to(element) {
    const previous_element = this.activeElement;
    if (previous_element === element) {
      return;
    }
    this.activeElement = element;
    previous_element.run_listeners(build_event("blur", { target: previous_element, bubbles: false }), () => true);
  }

  find_open_dialog() {
    return [...this.elements.values()].find((element) => element.tagName === DIALOG_TAG_NAME && element.open) ?? null;
  }

  dispatch(target, event) {
    event.target = target;
    const ancestors = [];
    for (let node = target.parent; node !== null; node = node.parent) {
      ancestors.unshift(node);
    }
    for (const node of [this, ...ancestors]) {
      node.run_listeners(event, (registration) => registration.capture);
      if (event.propagation_stopped) {
        return event;
      }
    }
    target.run_listeners(event, () => true);
    if (!event.bubbles || event.propagation_stopped) {
      return event;
    }
    for (const node of [...ancestors.reverse(), this]) {
      node.run_listeners(event, (registration) => !registration.capture);
      if (event.propagation_stopped) {
        return event;
      }
    }
    return event;
  }
}

class FakeTimers {
  constructor() {
    this.pending = new Map();
    this.next_handle = 1;
  }

  setTimeout(callback, delay_milliseconds) {
    const handle = this.next_handle;
    this.next_handle += 1;
    this.pending.set(handle, { callback, delay_milliseconds });
    return handle;
  }

  clearTimeout(handle) {
    this.pending.delete(handle);
  }

  run_pending_with_delay(delay_milliseconds) {
    for (const [handle, timer] of [...this.pending]) {
      if (timer.delay_milliseconds === delay_milliseconds) {
        this.pending.delete(handle);
        timer.callback();
      }
    }
  }
}

class FakeStorage {
  constructor(stored_values) {
    this.stored_values = new Map(Object.entries(stored_values ?? {}));
  }

  getItem(key) {
    return this.stored_values.get(key) ?? null;
  }

  setItem(key, value) {
    this.stored_values.set(key, String(value));
  }
}

class BlockedStorage {
  getItem() {
    throw new Error("The browser blocks the storage of this page.");
  }

  setItem() {
    throw new Error("The browser blocks the storage of this page.");
  }
}

// Read and compiled once per harness run; each scenario only runs them in a fresh context.
const PAGE_MARKUP = fs.readFileSync(path.join(STATIC_DIRECTORY, "index.html"), "utf8");
function compile_page_script(file_name) {
  return new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(path.join(STATIC_DIRECTORY, file_name), "utf8"), { filename: file_name });
}

const PAGE_SCRIPTS = PAGE_SCRIPT_FILE_NAMES.map(compile_page_script);

function build_json_response(status_code, body) {
  return { ok: status_code >= 200 && status_code < 300, status: status_code, json: async () => body };
}

function build_deferred_response() {
  const deferred = {};
  deferred.promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
    deferred.answer = resolve;
  });
  return deferred;
}

class BrowserPage {
  constructor(responses, storage) {
    this.responses = responses;
    this.storage = storage ?? new FakeStorage();
    this.requests = [];
    this.timers = new FakeTimers();
    this.document = new FakeDocument(PAGE_MARKUP);
    const browser_window = {
      setTimeout: (callback, delay_milliseconds) => this.timers.setTimeout(callback, delay_milliseconds),
      clearTimeout: (handle) => this.timers.clearTimeout(handle),
      localStorage: this.storage,
    };
    const context = vm.createContext({
      document: this.document,
      window: browser_window,
      fetch: (request_path, options) => this.fetch(request_path, options),
    });
    PAGE_SCRIPTS.forEach((script) => script.runInContext(context));
    this.context = context;
  }

  fetch(request_path, options) {
    const request_key = `${options.method} ${request_path}`;
    const body = options.body === undefined ? null : JSON.parse(options.body);
    this.requests.push({ key: request_key, headers: { ...options.headers }, body });
    const scripted = this.responses[request_key];
    // An array answers in turn and keeps repeating its last answer.
    const response = Array.isArray(scripted) ? (scripted.length > 1 ? scripted.shift() : scripted[0]) : scripted;
    // A request without a scripted answer stays pending, like a printer that has not answered yet.
    if (response === undefined) {
      return new Promise(() => {});
    }
    return response.promise ?? Promise.resolve(response);
  }

  async load() {
    this.document.run_listeners(build_event("DOMContentLoaded", { target: this.document }), () => true);
    await this.flush();
  }

  async flush() {
    for (let round = 0; round < FLUSH_ROUNDS; round += 1) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    }
  }

  element(element_identifier) {
    return this.document.getElementById(element_identifier);
  }

  active_element() {
    return this.document.activeElement;
  }

  dispatch_key(event_type, key_press) {
    const { code, target, repeat } = key_press;
    return this.document.dispatch(target, build_event(event_type, { code, repeat: repeat === true }));
  }

  async key_down(code) {
    return this.dispatch_key_down({ code, target: this.document.activeElement, repeat: false });
  }

  async repeat_key_down(code) {
    // What a held key sends after its first keydown.
    return this.dispatch_key_down({ code, target: this.document.activeElement, repeat: true });
  }

  async dispatch_key_down(key_press) {
    const { code, target } = key_press;
    const key_event = this.dispatch_key("keydown", key_press);
    if (!key_event.defaultPrevented && ENTER_KEY_CODES.includes(code) && target.tagName === BUTTON_TAG_NAME) {
      this.activate(target, KEYBOARD_CLICK_DETAIL);
    }
    const open_dialog = this.document.find_open_dialog();
    if (!key_event.defaultPrevented && code === ESCAPE_KEY_CODE && open_dialog !== null) {
      open_dialog.close();
    }
    await this.flush();
    return key_event;
  }

  async key_up(code, key_down_event) {
    const target = this.document.activeElement;
    const key_event = this.dispatch_key("keyup", { code, target, repeat: false });
    const is_activation = code === SPACE_KEY_CODE && target.tagName === BUTTON_TAG_NAME;
    if (is_activation && !key_event.defaultPrevented && !key_down_event.defaultPrevented) {
      this.activate(target, KEYBOARD_CLICK_DETAIL);
    }
    await this.flush();
    return key_event;
  }

  async press_key(code) {
    const key_down_event = await this.key_down(code);
    await this.key_up(code, key_down_event);
    return key_down_event;
  }

  activate(element, click_detail) {
    // Browsers never deliver a click to a disabled button.
    if (!element.disabled) {
      this.document.dispatch(element, build_event("click", { detail: click_detail }));
    }
  }

  async click(element) {
    element.focus();
    this.activate(element, POINTER_CLICK_DETAIL);
    await this.flush();
  }

  async press_with_keyboard(element) {
    element.focus();
    await this.press_key("Enter");
  }

  async drag_and_drop(drag_parts) {
    const { dragged_element, target_element, pointer_horizontal_position } = drag_parts;
    const transferred_data = new Map();
    const data_transfer = {
      effectAllowed: "",
      dropEffect: "",
      setData: (format, value) => transferred_data.set(format, value),
      getData: (format) => transferred_data.get(format) ?? "",
    };
    const pointer = { clientX: pointer_horizontal_position, dataTransfer: data_transfer };
    this.document.dispatch(dragged_element, build_event("dragstart", pointer));
    this.document.dispatch(target_element, build_event("dragover", pointer));
    this.document.dispatch(target_element, build_event("drop", pointer));
    this.document.dispatch(dragged_element, build_event("dragend", pointer));
    await this.flush();
  }

  dispatch_simple_event(element, event_type) {
    this.document.dispatch(element, build_event(event_type, { bubbles: false }));
  }

  count_requests(request_key) {
    return this.requests.filter((request) => request.key === request_key).length;
  }

  find_request(request_key) {
    return this.requests.find((request) => request.key === request_key) ?? null;
  }

  evaluate(expression) {
    return vm.runInContext(expression, this.context);
  }
}

module.exports = {
  BlockedStorage,
  BrowserPage,
  FakeDocument,
  FakeElement,
  FakeStorage,
  FakeTimers,
  build_deferred_response,
  build_event,
  build_json_response,
};
```

Substitua o conteúdo inteiro de `tests/web/scan-page-harness.js` por (o falso DOM sai para `fake-browser.js`; os cenários e as respostas são os mesmos, com `capture_mode: "single"` nos ajustes e `build_scan_page` no cenário que cria uma segunda página):

```javascript
"use strict";

// Runs the real static scripts in the fake browser of fake-browser.js (fake DOM, timers and fetch), plays each
// scenario and prints one JSON object with what the page did. tests/web/test_scan_page_behaviour.py asserts on it.

const { BrowserPage, build_json_response } = require("./fake-browser.js");

const ACTIVE_POLL_DELAY_MILLISECONDS = 500;
const PRINTER_POLL_DELAY_MILLISECONDS = 15000;
const POST_SCAN_PRINTER_DELAY_MILLISECONDS = 6000;
const BYTE_COUNTS = [0, 999, 1000, 999949, 999950, 1234567, 5e9];
const PAGE_COUNTS = [0, 1, 1234];

const SETTINGS = {
  output_folder: "/Users/teste/Digitalizadora",
  output_format: "pdf",
  scan_preset: "document",
  capture_mode: "single",
};
const AVAILABLE_STORAGE = { free_space_in_bytes: 12e9, estimated_pages_remaining: 4000, output_folder_available: true };
const LOW_STORAGE = { free_space_in_bytes: 1e9, estimated_pages_remaining: 300, output_folder_available: true };
const UNAVAILABLE_STORAGE = { free_space_in_bytes: 0, estimated_pages_remaining: 0, output_folder_available: false };
const CONFLICT_BODY = { code: "scan_already_running", message: "Já existe uma digitalização em andamento." };
const FINISHED_SCAN_RESULT = { file_name: "2026-10-17_00001.pdf", size_in_bytes: 1234567, scanned_at: "2026-10-17T10:00:00" };

function build_default_responses() {
  return {
    "GET /api/settings": build_json_response(200, SETTINGS),
    "GET /api/state": build_json_response(200, build_state("idle", AVAILABLE_STORAGE)),
    "GET /api/printer": build_json_response(200, build_printer("usb")),
  };
}

function build_state(scan_phase, storage) {
  return { scan_phase, scans_completed: 0, last_result: null, last_error: null, settings: SETTINGS, storage };
}

function build_printer(route) {
  return { connected: true, display_name: "DeskJet 2800", scanner_state: "idle", route, error: null };
}

class PageUnderTest extends BrowserPage {
  constructor(response_overrides) {
    super({ ...build_default_responses(), ...response_overrides });
  }

  async press_space(target, repeat) {
    const key_event = this.dispatch_key("keydown", { code: "Space", target, repeat });
    await this.flush();
    return key_event;
  }

  count_scan_requests() {
    return this.count_requests("POST /api/scans");
  }
}

const SCAN_STATE_OVERRIDES = { "GET /api/state": build_json_response(200, build_state("scanning", AVAILABLE_STORAGE)) };

async function load_page(response_overrides) {
  const page = new PageUnderTest(response_overrides);
  await page.load();
  return page;
}

async function count_scans_after_space_on(element_identifier) {
  const page = await load_page({});
  const key_event = await page.press_space(page.element(element_identifier), false);
  return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests(), default_prevented: key_event.defaultPrevented };
}

const SCENARIOS = {
  async space_on_the_page_body() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    const key_event = await page.press_space(page.document.body, false);
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests(), default_prevented: key_event.defaultPrevented };
  },
  space_on_the_scan_button: () => count_scans_after_space_on("scan-button"),
  space_in_the_folder_field: () => count_scans_after_space_on("output-folder-input"),
  space_on_the_preset_select: () => count_scans_after_space_on("preset-select"),
  space_on_a_format_option: () => count_scans_after_space_on("output-format-jpg"),
  space_on_the_folder_save_button: () => count_scans_after_space_on("output-folder-save-button"),
  async repeated_space_only() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    const key_event = await page.press_space(page.document.body, true);
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests(), default_prevented: key_event.defaultPrevented };
  },
  async held_space() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.press_space(page.document.body, false);
    await page.press_space(page.document.body, true);
    await page.press_space(page.document.body, true);
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests() };
  },
  async double_click_while_the_request_is_pending() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.click(page.element("scan-button"));
    await page.click(page.element("scan-button"));
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests(), button_disabled: page.element("scan-button").disabled };
  },
  async start_scan_called_twice_while_pending() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    const scan_page = page.evaluate("build_scan_page(collect_elements())");
    scan_page.start_scan();
    scan_page.start_scan();
    await page.flush();
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests() };
  },
  async space_during_a_scan() {
    const page = await load_page(SCAN_STATE_OVERRIDES);
    await page.press_space(page.document.body, false);
    return { scan_requests: page.count_scan_requests(), button_disabled: page.element("scan-button").disabled };
  },
  async idle_page() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    return {
      button_disabled: page.element("scan-button").disabled,
      status_text: page.element("status-line").textContent,
    };
  },
  async scanning_page() {
    const page = await load_page(SCAN_STATE_OVERRIDES);
    return { status_text: page.element("status-line").textContent };
  },
  async printer_poll_during_a_scan() {
    const page = await load_page(SCAN_STATE_OVERRIDES);
    const printer_requests_before = page.count_requests("GET /api/printer");
    page.timers.run_pending_with_delay(PRINTER_POLL_DELAY_MILLISECONDS);
    await page.flush();
    return { extra_printer_requests: page.count_requests("GET /api/printer") - printer_requests_before };
  },
  async printer_after_a_scan() {
    const page = await load_page(SCAN_STATE_OVERRIDES);
    const finished_state = { ...build_state("idle", AVAILABLE_STORAGE), scans_completed: 1, last_result: FINISHED_SCAN_RESULT };
    page.responses["GET /api/state"] = build_json_response(200, finished_state);
    // Gate 0: the printer still reports Processing for 4 to 5 s after it delivers the page.
    page.responses["GET /api/printer"] = build_json_response(200, { ...build_printer("usb"), scanner_state: "processing" });
    const printer_requests_before = page.count_requests("GET /api/printer");
    page.timers.run_pending_with_delay(ACTIVE_POLL_DELAY_MILLISECONDS);
    await page.flush();
    const immediate_printer_requests = page.count_requests("GET /api/printer") - printer_requests_before;
    const chip_text_right_after = page.element("printer-status-text").textContent;
    page.responses["GET /api/printer"] = build_json_response(200, build_printer("usb"));
    page.timers.run_pending_with_delay(POST_SCAN_PRINTER_DELAY_MILLISECONDS);
    await page.flush();
    return {
      immediate_printer_requests,
      chip_text_right_after,
      delayed_printer_requests: page.count_requests("GET /api/printer") - printer_requests_before,
      chip_text_after_the_delay: page.element("printer-status-text").textContent,
    };
  },
  async scan_request_headers() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.click(page.element("scan-button"));
    const scan_request = page.requests.find((request) => request.key === "POST /api/scans");
    return { headers: scan_request.headers };
  },
  async conflict_answer() {
    const page = await load_page({ "POST /api/scans": build_json_response(409, CONFLICT_BODY) });
    await page.click(page.element("scan-button"));
    return {
      banner_hidden: page.element("error-banner-content").hidden,
      banner_text: page.element("error-banner-text").textContent,
    };
  },
  async unavailable_output_folder() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/state": build_json_response(200, build_state("idle", UNAVAILABLE_STORAGE)),
    });
    return {
      storage_text: page.element("storage-line").textContent,
      warning_hidden: page.element("storage-warning").hidden,
    };
  },
  async low_free_space() {
    const page = await load_page({ "GET /api/state": build_json_response(200, build_state("idle", LOW_STORAGE)) });
    return { warning_hidden: page.element("storage-warning").hidden };
  },
  async printer_on_usb() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    return { chip_text: page.element("printer-status-text").textContent };
  },
  async printer_on_wifi() {
    const page = await load_page({ "GET /api/printer": build_json_response(200, build_printer("network")) });
    return { chip_text: page.element("printer-status-text").textContent };
  },
  async byte_counts() {
    const page = new PageUnderTest({});
    return Object.fromEntries(BYTE_COUNTS.map((count) => [count, page.evaluate(`format_byte_count(${count})`)]));
  },
  async page_counts() {
    const page = new PageUnderTest({});
    return Object.fromEntries(PAGE_COUNTS.map((count) => [count, page.evaluate(`describe_pages_remaining(${count})`)]));
  },
};

async function main() {
  const results = {};
  for (const [scenario_name, play_scenario] of Object.entries(SCENARIOS)) {
    results[scenario_name] = await play_scenario();
  }
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(results));
}

main().catch((error) => {
  process.stderr.write(`${error.stack}\n`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

Em `tests/web/test_scan_page_behaviour.py`, substitua por inteiro `SCANNING_MESSAGE` (o texto de "Digitalizando…" passa a vir do preset salvo, e os ajustes do harness usam o preset "document"):

```python
SCANNING_MESSAGE = "Digitalizando… (cerca de 15 s)"
```

Crie `tests/web/document-panel-harness.js` (o harness do modo Documento; não é um módulo de teste):

```javascript
"use strict";

// Plays the Documento mode scenarios named on the command line against the real static scripts in the fake browser
// of fake-browser.js and prints one JSON object with what the page did in each. The three test modules
// tests/web/test_document_panel_*.py each ask for their own scenarios, so each Node run stays short.

const {
  BlockedStorage,
  BrowserPage,
  FakeStorage,
  build_deferred_response,
  build_json_response,
} = require("./fake-browser.js");

const DRAFT_SESSION = "5c0f9a2e7b1d4c38";
const FIRST_PAGE = "0000000000000001";
const SECOND_PAGE = "0000000000000002";
const THIRD_PAGE = "0000000000000003";
const FOURTH_PAGE = "0000000000000004";
const THREE_PAGES = [FIRST_PAGE, SECOND_PAGE, THIRD_PAGE];
const FOUR_PAGES = [...THREE_PAGES, FOURTH_PAGE];
const PAGE_SIZE_IN_BYTES = 806123;
const SCANNED_AT = "2026-10-17T10:00:00-03:00";
const POLL_DELAYS_MILLISECONDS = [0, 500, 2000];
const TILE_BUTTON_INDEXES = Object.freeze({ move_left: 0, move_right: 1, delete: 2, move_to: 3 });
const RECOVERY_SWITCH_STORAGE_KEY = "digitalizadora.recovery_switch_session";
const TILE_ACTIONS_INDEX = 3;
const RIGHT_HALF_POSITION = 90;

const QUICK_SETTINGS = {
  output_folder: "/Users/teste/Digitalizadora",
  output_format: "pdf",
  scan_preset: "document",
  capture_mode: "single",
};
const DOCUMENT_SETTINGS = { ...QUICK_SETTINGS, capture_mode: "document" };
const AVAILABLE_STORAGE = { free_space_in_bytes: 12e9, estimated_pages_remaining: 4000, output_folder_available: true };
const DRAFT_STORAGE = { free_space_in_bytes: 12e9, estimated_pages_remaining: 4000, available: true };
const PRINTER = { connected: true, display_name: "DeskJet 2800", scanner_state: "idle", route: "usb", error: null };
const ACCEPTED_BODY = { accepted: true };
const FINALIZED_BODY = {
  file_name: "Contrato.pdf",
  output_folder: "/Users/teste/Digitalizadora",
  page_count: 3,
  size_in_bytes: 2418369,
};
const LAST_FINISHED_DOCUMENT = { ...FINALIZED_BODY, finalized_at: "2026-10-17T10:05:00-03:00" };
const LAST_SCAN_RESULT = {
  file_name: "2026-10-17_00001.pdf",
  output_folder: "/Users/teste/Digitalizadora",
  output_format: "pdf",

};
const RESUMED_RECOVERY = { outcome: "resumed", kept_page_count: 3, dropped_page_positions: [], set_aside_folder: null };
const SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING_BODY = {

};

function build_page(page_identifier) {
  return {
    page_identifier,
    scanned_at: SCANNED_AT,
    dots_per_inch: 300,
    color_mode: "color",
    size_in_bytes: PAGE_SIZE_IN_BYTES,
  };
}

function build_draft(page_identifiers, name) {
  return {
    name,
    created_at: SCANNED_AT,
    page_count: page_identifiers.length,
    estimated_size_in_bytes: page_identifiers.length * PAGE_SIZE_IN_BYTES,
    finalization_started_at: null,
    finished_document_path: null,
    pages: page_identifiers.map(build_page),
  };
}

function build_document_body(body_parts) {
  const { revision, page_identifiers, name, recovery, last_finished_document } = body_parts;
  return {
    draft_session: DRAFT_SESSION,
    revision,
    document: page_identifiers.length === 0 ? null : build_draft(page_identifiers, name ?? ""),
    recovery: recovery ?? null,
    last_finished_document: last_finished_document ?? null,
  };
}

function build_state(state_parts) {
  const { revision, page_count, scans_completed, last_result, settings } = state_parts;
  return {
    scan_phase: state_parts.scan_phase ?? "idle",
    scans_completed: scans_completed ?? 0,
    last_result: last_result ?? null,
    last_error: null,
    settings: settings ?? DOCUMENT_SETTINGS,
    storage: AVAILABLE_STORAGE,
    document: {
      draft_session: DRAFT_SESSION,
      revision,
      page_count,
      estimated_size_in_bytes: page_count * PAGE_SIZE_IN_BYTES,
      draft_storage: DRAFT_STORAGE,
    },
  };
}

function respond(body) {
  return build_json_response(200, body);
}

function build_default_responses() {
  return {
    "GET /api/settings": respond(DOCUMENT_SETTINGS),
    "PUT /api/settings": respond(DOCUMENT_SETTINGS),
    "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 1, page_count: 3 })),
    "GET /api/printer": respond(PRINTER),
    "GET /api/document": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 1, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES })),
    "POST /api/document/pages": build_json_response(202, ACCEPTED_BODY),
    "DELETE /api/document/pages/last": respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [FIRST_PAGE, SECOND_PAGE] }),
    ),
    [`DELETE /api/document/pages/${SECOND_PAGE}`]: respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [FIRST_PAGE, THIRD_PAGE] }),
    ),
    "PUT /api/document/name": respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES, name: "Contrato" }),
    ),
    "POST /api/document/finalize": respond(FINALIZED_BODY),
    "DELETE /api/document": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [] })),
  };
}

function build_recovered_quick_responses() {
  return {
    "GET /api/settings": respond(QUICK_SETTINGS),
    "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 0, page_count: 3, settings: QUICK_SETTINGS })),
    "GET /api/document": respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 0, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES, recovery: RESUMED_RECOVERY }),
    ),
  };
}

class DocumentPageUnderTest extends BrowserPage {
  constructor(response_overrides, storage) {
    super({ ...build_default_responses(), ...response_overrides }, storage);
  }

  tile_at(position) {
    return this.element("document-page-grid").children[position - 1];
  }

  tile_button(position, button_name) {
    return this.tile_at(position).children[TILE_ACTIONS_INDEX].children[TILE_BUTTON_INDEXES[button_name]];
  }

  grid_page_identifiers() {
    return this.element("document-page-grid").children.map((tile) => tile.dataset.pageIdentifier);
  }

  describe_focus() {
    const focused_element = this.active_element();
    const tile = focused_element.parent?.parent ?? null;
    return {
      label: focused_element.getAttribute("aria-label"),
      page_identifier: tile === null ? null : tile.dataset.pageIdentifier ?? null,
    };
  }

  is_focused(element_identifier) {
    return this.active_element() === this.element(element_identifier);
  }

  banner() {
    return { hidden: this.element("error-banner-content").hidden, text: this.element("error-banner-text").textContent };
  }

  async poll(state) {
    this.responses["GET /api/state"] = respond(state);
    for (const delay_milliseconds of POLL_DELAYS_MILLISECONDS) {
      this.timers.run_pending_with_delay(delay_milliseconds);
    }
    await this.flush();
  }

  async type_name(name) {
    const name_input = this.element("document-name-input");
    name_input.focus();
    name_input.value = name;
    await this.flush();
  }

  async open_and_accept_the_finalize_confirmation() {
    await this.click(this.element("finalize-document-button"));
    await this.click(this.element("confirmation-accept-button"));
  }

  count_name_requests() {
    return this.count_requests("PUT /api/document/name");
  }

  list_name_request_bodies() {
    return this.requests.filter((request) => request.key === "PUT /api/document/name").map((request) => request.body);
  }
}

async function load_page(response_overrides, storage) {
  const page = new DocumentPageUnderTest(response_overrides, storage);
  await page.load();
  return page;
}

async function play_first_page_after_a_draft_end(page) {
  const name_requests_before = page.count_name_requests();
  page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(build_document_body({ revision: 5, page_identifiers: [FIRST_PAGE] }));
  await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 5, page_count: 1, scans_completed: 1 }));
  return page.count_name_requests() - name_requests_before;
}

      dialog_open: page.element("confirmation-dialog").open,
      finalize_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/finalize"),
      page_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/pages"),
    };
  },
  async escape_in_the_confirmation() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    page.element("scan-button").focus();
    await page.press_key("Enter");
    await page.press_key("Escape");
    return {
      dialog_open: page.element("confirmation-dialog").open,
      finalize_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/finalize"),
      scan_button_focused: page.is_focused("scan-button"),
    };
  },
  async move_to_dialog() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.click(page.tile_button(3, "move_to"));
    const position_input = page.element("move-page-position-input");
    return { position_value: position_input.value, is_position_selected: position_input.is_text_selected };
  },
  async name_after_finalizing() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.type_name("Contrato");
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 3, page_identifiers: [], last_finished_document: LAST_FINISHED_DOCUMENT }),
    );
    await page.open_and_accept_the_finalize_confirmation();
    const name_field = page.element("document-name-input").value;
    return {
      name_field,
      finished_text: page.element("document-finished-message").textContent,
      scan_button_focused: page.is_focused("scan-button"),
      name_requests_for_the_next_first_page: await play_first_page_after_a_draft_end(page),
    };
  },
  async name_after_cancelling() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.type_name("Contrato");
    await page.click(page.element("cancel-document-button"));
    const reject_button_focused = page.is_focused("confirmation-reject-button");
    const question = page.element("confirmation-text").textContent;
    await page.click(page.element("confirmation-accept-button"));
    return {
      reject_button_focused,
      question,
      cancel_requests: page.count_requests("DELETE /api/document"),
      name_field: page.element("document-name-input").value,
      name_requests_for_the_next_first_page: await play_first_page_after_a_draft_end(page),
    };
  },
  async name_after_removing_the_only_page_here() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 1, page_count: 1 })),
      "GET /api/document": respond(
        build_document_body({ revision: 1, page_identifiers: [FIRST_PAGE], name: "Contrato" }),
      ),
      "DELETE /api/document/pages/last": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [] })),
    });
    await page.click(page.element("discard-last-page-button"));
    const name_field = page.element("document-name-input").value;
    await play_first_page_after_a_draft_end(page);
    const name_request = page.find_request("PUT /api/document/name");
    return { name_field, name_request_body: name_request === null ? null : name_request.body };
  },
  async name_left_while_a_page_scans() {
    const page = await load_page({ "PUT /api/document/name": build_json_response(409, SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING_BODY) });
    await page.press_key("Space");
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 1, page_count: 3, scans_completed: 3, scan_phase: "scanning" }));
    await page.type_name("Contrato");
    page.element("output-folder-input").focus();
    await page.flush();
    const name_requests_during_the_scan = page.count_name_requests();
    page.responses["PUT /api/document/name"] = respond(
      build_document_body({ revision: 3, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES, name: "Contrato" }),
    );
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES }));
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 2, page_count: 4, scans_completed: 4 }));
    return {
      name_requests_during_the_scan,
      name_bodies_after_the_page_lands: page.list_name_request_bodies().slice(name_requests_during_the_scan),
      name_field: page.element("document-name-input").value,
    };
  },
  async enter_in_the_name_field_during_a_scan() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "PUT /api/document/name": respond(
        build_document_body({ revision: 3, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES, name: "Contrato" }),
      ),
    });
    await page.press_key("Space");
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 1, page_count: 3, scans_completed: 3, scan_phase: "scanning" }));
    await page.type_name("Contrato");
    await page.press_key("Enter");
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES }));
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 2, page_count: 4, scans_completed: 4 }));
    const page_requests_before = page.count_requests("POST /api/document/pages");
    await page.press_key("Space");
    return {
      name_requests: page.count_name_requests(),
      new_page_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/pages") - page_requests_before,
    };
  },
  async refused_name_on_finalize() {
    const page = await load_page({ "PUT /api/document/name": build_json_response(422, INVALID_DOCUMENT_NAME_BODY) });
    await page.type_name("Nome recusado");
    await page.open_and_accept_the_finalize_confirmation();
    return {
      finalize_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/finalize"),
      name_field_focused: page.is_focused("document-name-input"),
      banner: page.banner(),
    };
  },
  async during_finalization() {
    const finalize_answer = build_deferred_response();
    const page = await load_page({ "POST /api/document/finalize": finalize_answer });
    await page.open_and_accept_the_finalize_confirmation();
    const during = {
      button_disabled: page.element("scan-button").disabled,
      button_label: page.element("scan-button-label").textContent,
      status_text: page.element("status-line").textContent,
    };
    await page.press_key("Space");
    return { ...during, page_requests: page.count_requests("POST /api/document/pages") };
  },
  async older_answer_after_a_newer_one() {
    const older_answer = build_deferred_response();
    const page = await load_page({});
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = [
      older_answer,
      respond(build_document_body({ revision: 3, page_identifiers: [THIRD_PAGE] })),
    ];
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 2, page_count: 2 }));
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 3, page_count: 1 }));
    older_answer.answer(respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [FIRST_PAGE, THIRD_PAGE] })));
    await page.flush();
    return { page_identifiers: page.grid_page_identifiers() };
  },
  async conflict_on_discard() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "DELETE /api/document/pages/last": build_json_response(409, SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING_BODY),
    });
    await page.click(page.element("discard-last-page-button"));
    return { banner: page.banner(), page_identifiers: page.grid_page_identifiers() };
  },
  async busy_document_on_add_page() {
    const page = await load_page({ "POST /api/document/pages": build_json_response(409, DOCUMENT_BUSY_BODY) });
    await page.press_key("Space");
    return { banner: page.banner() };
  },
  async stale_page_order() {
    const page = await load_page({ "PUT /api/document/page-order": build_json_response(422, INVALID_PAGE_ORDER_BODY) });
    const document_requests_before = page.count_requests("GET /api/document");
    await page.click(page.tile_button(2, "move_right"));
    return {
      banner: page.banner(),
      extra_document_requests: page.count_requests("GET /api/document") - document_requests_before,
    };
  },
  async damaged_page_on_finalize() {
    const page = await load_page({ "POST /api/document/finalize": build_json_response(409, DAMAGED_PAGE_BODY) });
    await page.open_and_accept_the_finalize_confirmation();
    const damaged_identifiers = page
      .element("document-page-grid")
      .children.filter((tile) => tile.classList.contains("is-damaged"))
      .map((tile) => tile.dataset.pageIdentifier);
    return { damaged_identifiers, focus: page.describe_focus(), banner: page.banner() };
  },
  async recovered_draft_in_quick_mode() {
    const page = await load_page(build_recovered_quick_responses());
    const settings_request = page.find_request("PUT /api/settings");
    return {
      settings_request_body: settings_request === null ? null : settings_request.body,
      section_hidden: page.element("document-section").hidden,
      notice_hidden: page.element("document-recovery-notice").hidden,
      notice_text: page.element("document-recovery-notice").textContent,
      remembered_draft_session: page.storage.getItem(RECOVERY_SWITCH_STORAGE_KEY),
    };
  },
  async recovered_draft_already_switched_in_quick_mode() {
    const storage = new FakeStorage({ [RECOVERY_SWITCH_STORAGE_KEY]: DRAFT_SESSION });
    const page = await load_page(build_recovered_quick_responses(), storage);
    return {
      settings_requests: page.count_requests("PUT /api/settings"),
      section_hidden: page.element("document-section").hidden,
    };
  },
  async recovered_draft_with_blocked_storage() {
    const page = await load_page(build_recovered_quick_responses(), new BlockedStorage());
    return { settings_requests: page.count_requests("PUT /api/settings") };
  },
  async reload_with_a_draft_in_quick_mode() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/settings": respond(QUICK_SETTINGS),
      "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 4, page_count: 3, settings: QUICK_SETTINGS })),
      "GET /api/document": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 4, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES })),
    });
    return {
      settings_requests: page.count_requests("PUT /api/settings"),
      section_hidden: page.element("document-section").hidden,
      pending_notice_hidden: page.element("document-pending-notice").hidden,
      pending_text: page.element("document-pending-text").textContent,
      button_label: page.element("scan-button-label").textContent,
    };
  },
  async return_to_document_mode() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/settings": respond(QUICK_SETTINGS),
      "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 4, page_count: 3, settings: QUICK_SETTINGS })),
    });
    await page.click(page.element("return-to-document-button"));
    return {
      settings_request_body: page.find_request("PUT /api/settings").body,
      section_hidden: page.element("document-section").hidden,
      pending_notice_hidden: page.element("document-pending-notice").hidden,
    };
  },
  async return_button_during_a_quick_scan() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/settings": respond(QUICK_SETTINGS),
      "GET /api/state": respond(
        build_state({ revision: 4, page_count: 3, settings: QUICK_SETTINGS, scan_phase: "scanning" }),
      ),
      "GET /api/document": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 4, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES })),
    });
    const return_button = page.element("return-to-document-button");
    const is_disabled_while_scanning = return_button.disabled;
    await page.click(return_button);
    return {
      is_disabled_while_scanning,
      settings_requests: page.count_requests("PUT /api/settings"),
    };
  },
  async mode_selector() {
    const page = await load_page({ "PUT /api/settings": respond(QUICK_SETTINGS) });
    const single_mode_input = page.element("capture-mode-single");
    single_mode_input.checked = true;
    page.dispatch_simple_event(single_mode_input, "change");
    await page.flush();
    return {
      settings_request_body: page.find_request("PUT /api/settings").body,
      section_hidden: page.element("document-section").hidden,
      button_label: page.element("scan-button-label").textContent,
    };
  },
  async last_scan_panel_in_document_mode() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/state": respond(
        build_state({ revision: 1, page_count: 3, scans_completed: 1, last_result: LAST_SCAN_RESULT }),
      ),
    });
    return { last_scan_panel_hidden: page.element("last-scan-panel").hidden };
  },
  async finished_document_seen_from_another_tab() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "GET /api/state": respond(build_state({ revision: 6, page_count: 0 })),
      "GET /api/document": respond(
        build_document_body({ revision: 6, page_identifiers: [], last_finished_document: LAST_FINISHED_DOCUMENT }),
      ),
    });
    return {
      finished_hidden: page.element("document-finished-message").hidden,
      finished_text: page.element("document-finished-message").textContent,
    };
  },
  async page_added() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES }));
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 2, page_count: 4, scans_completed: 1 }));
    return { status_text: page.element("status-line").textContent, page_count: page.grid_page_identifiers().length };
  },
  async status_after_discarding_an_added_page() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "DELETE /api/document/pages/last": respond(build_document_body({ revision: 3, page_identifiers: THREE_PAGES })),
    });
    page.responses["GET /api/document"] = respond(build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: FOUR_PAGES }));
    await page.poll(build_state({ revision: 2, page_count: 4, scans_completed: 1 }));
    page.element("scan-button").focus();
    await page.press_key("Backspace");
    return { status_text: page.element("status-line").textContent };
  },
  async drag_and_drop() {
    const page = await load_page({
      "PUT /api/document/page-order": respond(
        build_document_body({ revision: 2, page_identifiers: [SECOND_PAGE, THIRD_PAGE, FIRST_PAGE] }),
      ),
    });
    const dragged_tile = page.tile_at(1);
    await page.drag_and_drop({
      dragged_element: dragged_tile,
      target_element: page.tile_at(3),
      pointer_horizontal_position: RIGHT_HALF_POSITION,
    });
    return {
      order_body: page.find_request("PUT /api/document/page-order").body,
      same_tile_kept: page.tile_at(3) === dragged_tile,
      scan_button_focused: page.is_focused("scan-button"),
    };
  },
  async escape_in_the_name_field() {
    const page = await load_page({});
    await page.type_name("Contrato");
    await page.press_key("Escape");
    return {
      scan_button_focused: page.is_focused("scan-button"),
      name_request_body: page.find_request("PUT /api/document/name").body,
    };
  },
};

async function main() {
  const results = {};
  for (const scenario_name of process.argv.slice(2)) {
    results[scenario_name] = await SCENARIOS[scenario_name]();
  }
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(results));
}

main().catch((error) => {
  process.stderr.write(`${error.stack}\n`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
```

Crie `tests/web/panel_scenario_runner.py` (o que os três módulos de teste do painel compartilham: roda o harness do Node com os cenários pedidos; não é um módulo de teste):

```python
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

NODE_EXECUTABLE = shutil.which("node")
HARNESS_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "document-panel-harness.js"
HARNESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30


def run_panel_scenarios(scenario_names: tuple[str, ...]) -> dict:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [NODE_EXECUTABLE, str(HARNESS_PATH), *scenario_names],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=HARNESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        check=False,
    )
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    return json.loads(completed.stdout)
```

Os testes do painel ficam em três módulos, cada um com o seu `scenario_results` (uma execução do Node só com os cenários que ele lê), para que o `setup` do primeiro teste de cada um fique abaixo de 100 ms.

Crie `tests/web/test_document_panel_behaviour.py` (o que a página mostra: a barra do documento, a grade, a linha de status, o modo e a retomada):
